species.0.description: A tiny bird’s-eye chilli dragon: spicy, stubborn and brave.
species.1.description: A food-stall garden civet with a fragrant pandan-leaf tail.
species.2.description: A hermit crab that lives inside a refillable water jug.
species.3.description: A pangolin fascinated by Indonesia’s silver street performers.
species.4.description: A nimble parking-whistle chicken. It halts turns and confiscates the opponent’s big moves.
species.5.description: A gecko living on prepaid electricity meters. Its call reminds you to top up.
species.6.description: A meatball buffalo as sturdy as a well-loved soup bowl.
species.7.description: A frog wrapped in a banana-leaf jacket. Loves damp places.
species.8.description: A beetle with crispy fried-tempeh armour: crunchy but tough.
species.9.description: A tortoise with an angkot (minibus) shell and a hot engine. Departs only when full.
species.10.description: A cloud bat that appears when your Wi-Fi drops to one bar.
species.12.description: An adult chilli dragon whose wings stir hot air like a sizzling sambal pan.
species.13.description: An adult pandan civet whose lush tail can shade an entire food cart.
species.14.description: A giant water-dispenser hermit crab with two tap-shaped claws.
species.15.description: An adult pangolin with layered silver armour.
species.16.description: An adult gecko whose call rattles every electricity meter in the neighbourhood.
species.17.description: An adult coconut rhino. Its shell has become a living fortress.
species.18.description: A rare Bali starling living near substations. Conductive feather tips disrupt enemy moves with short circuits. It can be encountered again at Puncak Sinyal.
species.19.description: The legendary manta guardian of the sanctuary. It soaks opponents, channels electricity and protects its companions. Only one can be caught per journey.
species.20.description: A tiny slow loris with coffee-bean ears. Its eyes stay bright long after the neighbourhood meeting should have ended.
species.21.description: A coconut-coated klepon rabbit. Its palm-sugar tail leaves a sweet, sticky trail.
species.22.description: A little river companion with cendol gills. Its coconut-milk belly stores cool drinks for the team.
species.23.description: A durian hedgehog that prefers hugs from the front. Sweet face, uncompromising spines.
species.24.description: A cracker crab wearing a crunchy coat. After rain, it asks for a moment in the sun.
species.25.description: A little reef cuttlefish. Its golden spots blink like lights on a fishing boat.
species.26.description: A cheerful living kite carried by the kampung wind. Its ribbon tail dances above the rooftops.
species.27.description: A chocolate-spotted martabak gecko. Soft body, determination as thick as a special-order pancake.
species.28.description: A glowing fruit companion that guides frightened friends through the dark.
species.29.description: A scaly salak fruit bat with pale cheeks. Its astringent sap interferes with enemy healing.
species.30.description: An adult Kleponci with a round coconut body and palm-sugar ribbon ears. It bounces between its companions and danger.
species.31.description: Cendolotl grows into a long river dragon with cendol-jelly crests and palm-sugar horns.
species.32.description: An adult reef cuttlefish with a broad mantle. Its golden glow guides fishing boats home.
species.33.description: Mangglow spreads wide leaf wings. Manggantara glides like a fruit bat, carrying mangosteen seeds to new gardens.
species.34.description: A commuter mouse with ticket-shaped ears. Its tail stores static from train seats; it always queues behind the yellow line.
species.35.description: A tempeh gecko with a sturdy soybean shell. It still likes clinging affectionately to your lunch bag.
species.36.description: A tiny satay hedgehog with wooden-skewer spines. Its peanut-scented cheeks and gentle embers warm the group.
species.37.description: An adult Satecil with a stone-grill back. Its warm satay spines never prick its friends.
species.38.description: A little cockatoo with a clove crest. Its wings dry damp trails and warm meals without burning them.
species.39.description: A pangolin with a pedicab-canopy shell. It carries smaller friends through workshop alleys.
species.40.description: A water squirrel with a lotus-leaf tail. Its petals collect clean dew for the park’s residents.
species.41.description: An adult Teratupai with a lotus crown and broad leaf tail: the reservoir birds’ favourite resting place.
species.42.description: A little mouse-deer with pumice shoes. Its glowing footprints guide hikers away from hot ground.
species.43.description: Its lava antlers shine through the mist. Kancilava guards evacuation routes rather than chasing hikers.
species.44.description: A blue irrigation-channel eel. Its yellow fins store microhydro energy to light the rice fields.
species.45.description: An adult Belutara guarding the sluice gates. Its body glows when the kampung generator starts again.
species.46.description: A Bornean sun bear with a golden chest crescent. It carries honey in a rattan bag and protects the bees’ trees.
species.47.description: A tarsier guarding the observatory, once a companion to its missing researchers. Its metal rings turn electricity into shields. It waits for someone to restore the signal home.
species.48.description: A little civet sleeping near satay stoves. Its whiskers hold embers, but its soft paws never scorch the ground.
species.49.description: An adult Baraong with a glowing charcoal mane. It protects night vendors by keeping the heat inside its fur.
species.50.description: A stone gecko from volcanic slopes. Amber crystals store static electricity from volcanic dust.
species.51.description: An adult Andesit with stone plates and crystal fins. It directs lightning away from hillside homes.
species.52.description: An adult Parkiram with a whistle crest and reflective feathers. One wingbeat restores order to an entire terminal.
species.53.description: An adult Baksobanteng wearing stone-meatball armour. Its noodle horns lift carts out of potholes.
species.54.description: An adult Kopikukang that keeps the ronda (night watch) company. It picks only ripe coffee berries for its necklace.
trainer.0.line: A pendulum has a rhythm. Like a song, it follows a pattern.
trainer.0.win: Ya ampun, my pendulum swung wide. You’ve got the rhythm now.
trainer.1.line: Today’s content: tidy parking and fair battles. Cameras optional.
trainer.1.win: Neat moves. But don’t park your motorbike across the shop door, okay? I’m the one who gets told off.
trainer.2.line: My filming schedule is packed, the promo queue even more so. Hurry up and battle before the discount runs out!
trainer.2.win: I queued all morning, then lost the match. I hope the sale hasn't ended.
trainer.3.line: One business not enough? I opened two, obviously. Got a plan B?
trainer.3.win: I tried two plans. You read both of them. Fair enough.
trainer.4.line: They call me Anisbentar: a quick chat, a quick battle, then basudahan, all wrapped up. Simple as that.
trainer.4.win: Fine, you win. On the forest trail, take your rubbish home with you. Promise, okay?
trainer.5.line: They call me Prananjak, “the climber”, yet one little slope and my lungs call a meeting. Ya ampun.
trainer.5.win: I thought I knew every bend of this climb. Turns out you know it better.
trainer.6.line: One pot of pandan perfumes the whole alley.
trainer.6.win: I lost. I still have pandan to water before evening.
trainer.7.line: Teamwork matters more than a powerful smash here. Let’s practise!
trainer.7.win: Lovely serve! Fancy being our practice partner tomorrow?
trainer.8.line: One partner covers the other. Show me how your team works together.
trainer.8.win: You lot are so in sync. We’re practising again tomorrow. How embarrassing.
trainer.9.line: My name may sound like “running off”, but I’m not running from this battle! The parcel’s delivered, don’t worry.
trainer.9.win: Beaten first, typical. The next parcel has to beat the warung’s closing time. Bye!
trainer.10.line: Your papers are stamped. Want a quick match before you leave?
trainer.10.win: Wow, tight teamwork. Relax, the stamp on your papers still counts.
trainer.11.line: An angkot can wait for passengers. Your battle turn cannot.
trainer.11.win: You got me. My passengers are waiting, so I'd better get moving.
trainer.12.line: One guitar, a whole market watching. My team’s joining the gig. Ready to be the audience?
trainer.12.win: That was a good rhythm. I’ll listen for news of your match at Balai Beton.
trainer.13.line: The sand’s here, the cement’s mixed. Now let’s see whether you crumble.
trainer.13.win: At least it was my team that fell, not the arena wall.
trainer.14.line: I designed this arena. Before you meet the leader, test the foundations. Solid, right?
trainer.14.win: There is a gap in my arena design after all. I'll write that down.
trainer.15.line: The crowd’s here, the mic’s on. Testing, testing... let’s begin!
trainer.15.win: Write that down! You’re hard to beat. Even the committee is baffled.
trainer.16.line: Every morning I swim from the pier to the buoy. How long can you hold your breath?
trainer.16.win: I lost. Time to check the pool before the tide comes in.
trainer.17.line: You’ve passed all four stations. Now prove it in Arena Beton. Don’t go soft like wet cement!
trainer.17.win: Mantap jiwa, superb! Fine work. This Concrete Badge is well earned.
trainer.18.line: Water the plants, keep your spirit burning. Okay, that’s just the slogan on my T-shirt.
trainer.18.win: You got me. I'd better get back to planting before the sun gets too hot.
trainer.19.line: Ripe bananas. Your strategy should be ready too.
trainer.19.win: Your strategy is riper than the bananas on my stall.
trainer.20.line: Have a drink first, Cak. No arguing while thirsty, rek.
trainer.20.win: Right, I’m off for water. Battling you is thirsty work, rek.
trainer.21.line: Sharp questions can still have funny answers.
trainer.21.win: I ran out of questions and you still had answers. Not fair!
trainer.22.line: Tidy timetable, tidy queue. Is your team tidy too?
trainer.22.win: Very tidy teamwork. I’d better get back to the queue before someone pushes in.
trainer.23.line: Pitch ready, schedule set. Now show me what training got you!
trainer.23.win: Beaten on my own court. Embarrassing, but your line-up really is good.
trainer.24.line: Stir the crew’s coffee first. The battle scene is next.
trainer.24.win: Cut. That's the match done. I should get back to the stage crew.
trainer.25.line: Late-night vocal practice is fine. Sleeping through tomorrow is not.
trainer.25.win: My voice is fine. My team lost. I'll check the stage cables now.
trainer.26.line: Take care on the road, and even more care around electric currents.
trainer.26.win: You won. The Circuit Badge is yours, and the stage is ready again.
trainer.27.line: Smash first, talk later. The sea breeze plays on this court too.
trainer.27.win: Quick, aren’t you! I’ll go and practise my smash before the tide comes in.
trainer.28.line: What’s up with all this litter? Come on, let’s sweep it up together!
trainer.28.win: My team lost, but the beach still needs cleaning. Help me pick up litter by the mangroves?
trainer.29.line: Relax before the serve. Focus during the rally.
trainer.29.win: You won. The Tide Badge is yours. Look after this bay when you return.
trainer.30.line: The stars are not out yet. Let us take one step towards the dome.
trainer.30.win: You beat me. Let us watch the stars from the dome tonight.
trainer.31.line: Loving nature starts with staying on the marked trail.
trainer.31.win: I lost. The trail to the dome is still steep, mind. Rest first if your team is tired.
trainer.32.line: Calculate first, fly later. Orbits do not accept guesses.
trainer.32.win: The dome's signal is clear again. The Orbit Badge is yours.
trainer.33.line: Coffee in the jerrycan, not petrol. One flask per carriage.
trainer.33.win: You got me. The coffee at the platform is going cold. I'd better tend the thermos.
trainer.34.line: Fold your bag if you like. Never fold your resolve.
trainer.34.win: The Platform Badge is yours. The night market gets crowded, so take care on the way.
trainer.35.line: The seasoning packs a punch. Taste it before commenting.
trainer.35.win: You win. The delivery kitchen has orders that need to go out while they're hot.
trainer.36.line: The notes must be right. So must the flavour. Let us end the market on a sweet battle.
trainer.36.win: You win. Here is the Flavour Badge. Wargamall visitors will still be talking about this match tomorrow.
trainer.37.line: Engine will not start? Check the starter. Cannot win? Check your team.
trainer.37.win: You win. Come and see what’s jammed in the service panel. Probably a sulking bolt.
trainer.38.line: Speed is fine, boss, but never forget your team’s weak spots.
trainer.38.win: You win. The Assembly Badge is yours. I hope this workshop can help the reservoir residents too.
trainer.39.line: From rice field to reservoir, clean water needs everyone’s help.
trainer.39.win: You win. I’ll go and check the channels to the garden. The water likes to wander.
trainer.40.line: Balls go into hoops. Water goes into wells. Do not mix them up.
trainer.40.win: You win. The Dew Badge is yours. Thanks for helping with the water channels.
trainer.41.line: Packed your bag? A long trail needs supplies, not just inspirational quotes.
trainer.41.win: My team lost. The rocks on the path ahead are slippery, so take your time.
trainer.42.line: Climbing trains your breathing. Battling trains your decisions.
trainer.42.win: You made it up here with energy to spare. I need a break.
trainer.43.line: Solar cells charge the dome. Now find the signal that can wake its guardian.
trainer.43.win: You win. I'll send the dome's calibration results to the League organisers.
trainer.44.line: The sea does not wait for the hesitant. My team's current drags away anyone half-hearted.
trainer.44.win: You held against the current to the end. Three Elite members remain before the Champion.
trainer.45.line: I can stand still at a crossroads for an hour without blinking. Whoever wavers first, loses.
trainer.45.win: You didn't rush. That is the hardest part. Two Elite members remain.
trainer.46.line: A hot stage needs a cool head. Ready for the final note?
trainer.46.win: I lost. One more Elite member before the Champion.
trainer.47.line: I used to train muscles. Now I train teams. Breath and stamina, no skipping days.
trainer.47.win: Whoa, your stamina never ran out. Four matches down. The Champion waits on the podium.
trainer.48.line: You have reached the League. Lead all six teammates to become Champion!
trainer.48.win: Tough as nails! You are the new Nusantara League Champion.
region.0.goal: Collect Bu Sari’s supplies, then battle {trainer0}, {trainer1}, {trainer2}, and {trainer9} before requesting a travel permit.
region.0.questText: Collect supplies from Bu Sari, challenge the neighbours, then ask Pak RT for a travel permit.
region.0.story:
Bu Sari has packed supplies. Pak RT (the neighbourhood head) is holding the Inter-Neighbourhood League.

Get to know Sukamaju’s residents, then explore Padang Ojek, Gang Senggol and Hutan Pinggir Kota.

Once the village tasks are complete, continue to Pasar Rakyat and Arena Beton at Balai Beton.
region.1.goal: Deliver the supplies and defeat the three roadside challengers.
region.1.questText: Deliver the supplies and defeat the three roadside challengers.
region.1.story: Drivers are waiting for lunch at the ojek stand. Parking whistles compete with Wargamon calls. Deliver the parcel before exploring the forest.
region.2.goal: Collect three pieces of litter along the forest trail to open the terminal route.
region.2.questText: Collect three pieces of litter along the forest trail to open the terminal route.
region.2.story: Follow the dirt path around the pond. Collect litter and spring supplies, then use the connector to reach the southern Festival Arus road. From there, follow the road through Wargamall to Pasar Rakyat.
region.3.goal: Collect two stamps and a travel card, then face Iqbol by the southern stalls.
region.3.questText: Get a stamp from Bu Sri in the courtyard and Bu Imah inside the market hall. Exchange them with Pak Darto inside, then meet Iqbol by the southern stalls.
region.3.story: Pasar Rakyat welcomes you with food stalls and a waterfront. Bu Sri and Bu Imah provide two stamps; Pak Darto prepares your Arena Beton travel card.
region.4.goal: Enter Balai Beton, defeat four qualifiers, then win the Concrete Badge.
region.4.questText: Pass {trainer13}, {trainer14}, {trainer15}, and {trainer23}. {trainer17} leads the final test for the Concrete Badge.
region.4.story: The former Batavia civic hall now hosts the Arena Beton. {trainer14} prepared four training stations; {trainer17} leads the final test at the back of the hall.
region.5.goal: Battle {trainer24} and {trainer25}, power the panel, then challenge {trainer26}.
region.5.questText: Battle {trainer24} and {trainer25} to use the panel. Light all nine lamps, then meet {trainer26} on stage.
region.5.story: The Festival Arus stage has gone dark. {trainer24} and {trainer25} guard the panel until you are ready to help. Once power returns, {trainer26} waits on stage.
region.6.goal: Two volunteers → valve console → {trainer29} → optional Rajapari.
region.6.questText: Help the two volunteers, balance three water flows in the lab, then challenge {trainer29}. Rajapari appears after the badge; catching it is optional.
region.6.story: The sanctuary pump feeds the wrong channels. {trainer27} waits in Tide Arena; {trainer28} helps on the quay. The lab and arena occupy the two blue-roofed harbour offices.
region.7.goal: Two challengers → three signal patterns → {trainer32} → Orbit Badge.
region.7.questText: Battle {trainer30} and {trainer31}, repeat three signal patterns at the dome, then face {trainer32}. Jalakawatt waits afterward.
region.7.story: From Sela Station, the journey continues to the summit. {trainer30}, {trainer31}, and {trainer32} need help restoring the community weather monitor.
region.8.questText: Meet {trainer33}, rotate the rail switches, then challenge {trainer34}.
region.8.story: The reservoir route leads through the workshop to the commuter station. Connect the training switch to Platform 2. {trainer33} serves passengers coffee; {trainer34} waits in the plaza.
region.9.questText: Enter the Wargamall atrium, battle {trainer35}, deliver three warm orders to the food counters, then challenge {trainer36}.
region.9.story: The Wargamall atrium is busy with visitors and food stalls. {trainer35} runs the delivery kitchen; {trainer36} waits for three orders before the Taste Arena match.
region.10.questText: Meet {trainer37}, repair the three service gears, then challenge {trainer38}.
region.10.story: From the harbour, travellers climb to the workshop and the reservoir, then on to the station. Repair the jammed service gears. {trainer37} guards the workshop while {trainer38} prepares a match in its yard.
region.11.questText: Meet {trainer39}, reconnect the irrigation pipes, then challenge {trainer40}.
region.11.story: Water must reach the garden through connected pipes. {trainer39} asks for help before {trainer40} opens the final match. The workshop decision affects which Wargamon survive here.
region.12.questText: Face {trainer41} and {trainer42}. Stock up before climbing to the observatory.
region.12.story: The caldera road leads towards the League. {trainer41} and {trainer42} guard the climb; Bu Ramu teaches moves nearby.
region.13.goal: Meet the researcher to open League access. Return as Champion to help Tarsion.
region.13.questText: Meet the researcher to open League access. Return as Champion to help Tarsion.
region.13.story: The observatory sends the same signal each night. Tarsion is visible in the courtyard, waiting for the final calibration.
region.14.goal: Register → four Elite members → {trainer48} → Hall of Champions.
region.14.questText: Complete five consecutive battles: four Elite members and {trainer48}.
region.14.story: Every neighbourhood journey leads to the League. Four Elite members guard Current, Tempo, Ember and Stamina; {trainer48} defends the Champion title from the podium.
everyday.ui.22: Use Find wild Wargamon to reach an encounter spot.
everyday.ui.38: Jamu costs Rp12.000 and restores 30% HP, at least 40. Strong Jamu and Revival Balm are available at minimarkets and shops from Kota Beton onward.
everyday.species.55.role: Electric courier: clear a path and keep the rhythm
everyday.species.55.description: Its green helmet lights up when an order arrives. Ojeklit delivers meals without asking for five stars.
everyday.species.56.role: Hot wok: burn enemies at a personal cost
everyday.species.56.description: A little living wok from a street-food cart. Its fritter wings puff up as the oil heats.
everyday.species.57.role: Woven provisions: heal and protect the team
everyday.species.57.description: Its woven coconut leaves hold warm rice. It waits on the neighbours’ table after kerja bakti (community clean-up).
everyday.species.58.role: Ice cart: soak foes and absorb hits
everyday.species.58.description: Its tiny bell rings through the hottest alleys. Its lid keeps the ice cold for the whole ronda.
everyday.species.59.description: A pair of blue flip-flops that always gets mixed up on the porch. Its partner returns whenever someone whistles.
everyday.species.60.role: Packed rice: warm support and embers
everyday.species.60.description: A little rice packet with ember feet. It keeps dinner warm for night-shift workers.
everyday.species.61.role: Cash machine: lock moves and store energy
everyday.species.61.description: A little ATM with a receipt tongue and short legs. It keeps the neighbours’ spare coins, then returns them just before the warung closes.
everyday.species.62.role: Laundry: cleanse status and reset the rhythm
everyday.species.62.description: Towels and washing lines form its wings. It chases the sun before the afternoon rain arrives.
everyday.species.63.role: Gas stove: fiery pressure and punishment
everyday.species.63.description: A tiny stone-footed stove living in a warung kitchen. It hisses when its gas cylinder is crooked.
everyday.species.64.role: Night guard: lock moves and protect allies
everyday.species.64.description: A whistle beetle wearing a security vest. It politely checks visitors, then falls asleep in a plastic chair.
everyday.species.65.role: Crispy tofu: drain HP and burn enemies
everyday.species.65.description: A fried tofu cube with bean-sprout hair. It leaps out of the strainer when it smells fresh sambal.
everyday.species.66.description: A crispy cireng ball with a chewy centre. A careless attack may bounce right back.
everyday.species.67.role: Prepaid meter: build rhythm and disrupt power
everyday.species.67.description: A little electricity meter with yellow cheeks. Its low-credit alarm wakes the entire boarding house.
everyday.species.68.role: Warung tent: protect the team from the weather
everyday.species.68.description: A living blue-and-orange tarpaulin tent from a street-food stall. In heavy rain, it tightens its ropes to keep customers and fritters dry.
everyday.species.69.role: Stacked lunchbox: team recovery and protection
everyday.species.69.description: A stacked lunchbox turtle bringing food to neighbours. Each tier carries a different kitchen aroma.
species.55.role: Electric courier: clear a path and keep the rhythm
species.55.description: Its green helmet lights up when an order arrives. Ojeklit delivers meals without asking for five stars.
species.56.role: Hot wok: burn enemies at a personal cost
species.56.description: A little living wok from a street-food cart. Its fritter wings puff up as the oil heats.
species.57.role: Woven provisions: heal and protect the team
species.57.description: Its woven coconut leaves hold warm rice. It waits on the neighbours’ table after kerja bakti (community clean-up).
species.58.role: Ice cart: soak foes and absorb hits
species.58.description: Its tiny bell rings through the hottest alleys. Its lid keeps the ice cold for the whole ronda.
species.59.description: A pair of blue flip-flops that always gets mixed up on the porch. Its partner returns whenever someone whistles.
species.60.role: Packed rice: warm support and embers
species.60.description: A little rice packet with ember feet. It keeps dinner warm for night-shift workers.
species.61.role: Cash machine: lock moves and store energy
species.61.description: A little ATM with a receipt tongue and short legs. It keeps the neighbours’ spare coins, then returns them just before the warung closes.

species.62.description: Towels and washing lines form its wings. It chases the sun before the afternoon rain arrives.

species.63.description: A tiny stone-footed stove living in a warung kitchen. It hisses when its gas cylinder is crooked.

species.64.description: A whistle beetle wearing a security vest. It politely checks visitors, then falls asleep in a plastic chair.

species.65.description: A fried tofu cube with bean-sprout hair. It leaps out of the strainer when it smells fresh sambal.

species.69.role: Stacked lunchbox: team recovery and protection
species.69.description: A stacked lunchbox turtle bringing food to neighbours. Each tier carries a different kitchen aroma.
species.70.role: Sturdy courier: pierce shields and support allies
species.70.description: Ojeklit becomes a motorcycle-armoured raptor. Its delivery boxes turn into arm shields, while its dynamo tail stores power for steep climbs.
species.71.role: Twin woks: Fire pressure and Metal shields
species.71.description: Gorenggong becomes a flame-winged twin-wok guardian with metal handles as protective horns.
species.72.description: Ketupagung becomes a tall woven guardian with a janur crown and four leaf arms.
species.73.role: Mountain of ice: soak foes and control the flow
species.73.description: Serutara becomes an ice-mountain beast whose cart wheels turn into frozen hooves.
species.74.role: Hearty meal: restore the team and strike back
species.74.description: Bungkaraya becomes a kitchen guardian with ember shoulders and a steamed-rice shield.
species.75.role: Walking vault: absorb hits and disrupt enemies
species.75.description: Atmara becomes a standing vault guardian with two slots, a glowing keypad, receipt ribbons, and steel arms.
species.76.role: Tofu guardian: drain energy and protect allies
species.76.description: Tahuraya grows into a guardian in crispy tofu armour. Bean sprouts form a cape, while its crunchy shield protects friends across the neighbourhood.
species.77.role: Layered tapioca: reflect and break through
species.77.description: Cirenggulung becomes a spiral tapioca warrior with layered armour and a rolling shield.
species.78.description: Tokenyit grows into a walking substation with copper coils, cable arms, one face screen, and a hand that shares power with nearby homes.
species.79.description: Rantangkang rises into an upright four-tier lunchbox guardian. Its lids become shoulder shields, and its steel fists protect the neighbourhood's meals.
species.80.role: Fighter kite: pierce shields and cut the foe’s moves
species.80.description: A fish-shaped bebean kite from the beaches of Sanur. Its fins quiver whenever the east monsoon wind arrives.
species.81.role: Sky-ruling janggan: long tail slashes that cut through shields
species.81.description: Grown Bebeangin becomes a janggan, the giant Balinese kite with a bird head and a cloth tail hundreds of metres long. It hovers high above the shore, keeping watch.
species.81.evolutionChange: Small fish kite → bird-headed janggan with a long cloth tail.
species.82.role: Flying dish: reflect attacks, put foes to sleep and drain them
species.82.description: Grown Wifilawar sprouts satellite-dish wings. It catches signals from the sky and bounces attacks back like the dish on a rooftop.
species.82.evolutionChange: Cloud bat → bat with satellite-dish wings and antenna ears.
species.83.role: Small turbine: strong gusts and a rotor shield
species.83.description: A tiny windmill from a kampung workshop. Its blades spin hard enough to light one bulb at the night-watch post.
species.84.role: Walking wind farm: heavy gusts and electric current
species.84.description: Grown Kincilik towers like the Sidrap wind-farm turbines on the hills of South Sulawesi. Its three blades turn wind into electricity for the village below.
species.84.evolutionChange: Tiny windmill → tall three-bladed turbine on steel tower legs.
species.85.role: Sky guardian: break defences and shield the team
species.85.description: The legendary giant Javan hawk-eagle that guards the cliffs of Seberang. Its wing feathers are as hard as coral rock; one beat drives storms away from fishing boats. Only one can be caught per journey.
species.86.role: Little temple guard: stupa shield and stone throws
species.86.description: A tiny latticed stone stupa that woke up in a mossy temple. Inside its hollow, a small statue peeks at noisy visitors.
species.87.role: Dwarapala: take hits and answer with a heavy club
species.87.description: Stupik grows into a dwarapala, the gate-guardian statue of a temple holding a bronze club. Its eyes bulge, yet it always makes way for pilgrims.
species.87.evolutionChange: Small stupa → stone gate guardian with a bronze club.
species.88.role: Walking temple: the sturdiest shield and a quake that breaks defences
species.88.description: Grown Arcaraksa becomes a walking temple. The relief panels on its body tell of the kampungs it once protected, and the stupas on its shoulders ring like bells when the Dieng mist rolls in.
species.88.evolutionChange: Gate guardian → walking temple clad in relief panels with stupas on its shoulders.
species.89.role: Savanna rammer: venom, embers and tail blows
species.89.description: A large Komodo dragon from the eastern savanna. Its tail can smash a bamboo fence, but it would rather bask on a warm rock until the sun is high.
species.90.role: Seed spreader: drain HP and strong wingbeats
species.90.description: A Bornean hornbill with an orange casque. Its wingbeats sound like a gale over the canopy, and it plants the forest by scattering seeds everywhere.
species.91.role: Forest planter: drain HP and heal the team
species.91.description: An orange-haired orangutan carrying a pouch of tree seedlings. For every broken branch in Rimba Ulin it plants a new sapling.
species.92.role: Parade boss: burn foes and lock their moves
species.92.description: A giant ogoh-ogoh that wakes on Pengerupukan night before Nyepi. Paraded around the banjar with torches and baleganjur drums, it challenges anyone who has not gone home yet.
species.93.role: New Year dancer: small embers and luck for the team
species.93.description: A red-and-gold lion dancer that hops from shop to shop at Chinese New Year. It leaps between poles for red envelopes and leaves a fragrant trail of firecrackers.
species.94.role: Betawi giant: lively sway, drain HP and speed up the team
species.94.description: A fence-tall Betawi ondel-ondel that sways along to the tanjidor band. Its coconut-blossom crown scatters fresh leaves over the kampung road.
news.head: Three reports, one journey
news.intro: Kabar Warga follows the effects of your decisions from Kota Beton to the League. Publish after deciding; residents share the cost of documented restoration.
news.permit.headline: Two prices for one permit
news.permit.lead: The official fee and the back door in Kota Beton. What happened to the medicine delivery?
news.coast.headline: The pier and the nesting ground
news.coast.lead: Fishers need access. Rajapari needs a living bay.
news.contract.headline: Workshop orders, reservoir water
news.contract.lead: Jobs arrived before the waste filter did.
news.awaitChoice: Meet the source and decide what to do.
news.reward: Publish all three for a closing record in Balai Juara. The coast and workshop reports raise restoration funds.
news.complete: Archive complete. Residents sent two Ultra Capsules; your record awaits in Balai Juara.
ending.head: The towns shaped by your choices
ending.intro: A League title does not erase decisions made along the road. This record changes when you help residents deal with their effects.
ending.permit.unvisited: You have not decided how to handle the permit. Traders still await a clear delivery route.
ending.permit.officialPending: You chose the official counter. The follow-up delivery is still waiting in Neighbourhood News.
ending.permit.official: You chose the official counter. Medicine was delayed, then the cooperative delivered it without a broker.
ending.permit.brokerPending: Medicine arrived quickly after an under-the-table payment. Pak Map returned for another payment at Wargamall.
ending.permit.paid: Medicine arrived quickly, but the second payment kept the back channel alive.
ending.permit.reported: Medicine arrived quickly, then you reported the next demand. The broker's stall closed; the cooperative stayed open.
ending.coast.unvisited: You have not decided the coast's pier plan.
ending.coast.cooperative: The cooperative route protects fishers' access and Rajapari's nesting ground, paid for together.
ending.coast.damaged: The express pier helps fishers sell their catch, but blocks the nesting ground. Rajapari waits for the bay to recover.
ending.coast.restored: The express pier once blocked the nesting ground. Restoration contributions reopened Rajapari's route.
ending.contract.unvisited: You have not decided on the workshop contract.
ending.contract.safe: The workshop delayed orders until its drain was safe. Jobs came later; Belutara stayed in the reservoir.
ending.contract.polluted: The contract brought jobs and a dynamo, but runoff drove Belutara from the reservoir.
ending.contract.filtered: The contract brought jobs and a dynamo. After runoff damaged the habitat, a community filter restored the reservoir.
mart.staff.line: “Jamu on the left shelf, capsules at the till. Looking for discounts? Ask Kak Sela. She’s busy writing prices down anyway.”
mart.closed: The register is closed during the League run.
mart.sela.name: Kak Sela
mart.sela.intro: “I am comparing two prices for almost the same thing. Could you check the essentials shelf on the right?”
mart.sela.waiting: “Look at the essentials shelf on the right. Tell me what you find.”
mart.sela.checked: “Local and imported prices, recorded. Will you help tell the neighbours? I have a remedy for your journey.”
mart.sela.done: “One bottle, two worlds. At least we can still choose. Bring me stories from your next town.”
mart.sela.warm: “You are more interesting than a receipt. I will wait for your next story, no service charge.”
mart.prices.title: Everyday essentials
mart.prices.localDesc: Restores 30% HP, at least 40. Plain bottle, useful contents.
mart.prices.importDesc: Shiny packaging. Same benefit, a very different price.
mart.prices.return: Prices noted. Go back to Kak Sela by the left shelf.
mart.prices.done: Kak Sela has already published these notes.

trainer.40.rematch: Still as tough as ever. I’ll go and check the water flow.

tide.done: The sensors are stable. {trainer} is ready for a match. You received 3 capsules and 3 herbal drinks.
tide.hint: Each button moves one unit; the total stays at six.

tide.clue.2: Mangroves need the most. The research tank needs one less, and coral one less again.

food.mbg.offer: Today's meal: {dish}. Free. Team Fullness becomes 100. One teammate has a 5% chance of food poisoning.
food.mbg.done: {dish} fills the team. HP and conditions remain unchanged.

district.food: The banner covers half the alley. The owner wraps one portion in banana leaf and reminds you to take the litter home.
district.tree: Residents care for the roots and drainage. The cloth around the trunk reminds cart drivers to avoid damaging the tree.
district.vendor: Floodwater blocks the lane. Rent an expensive pump or help traders set down walking boards.
district.marketDrain: The pump works. Stalls are dry, but it draws power from market lights. Traders close earlier tonight.
district.marketStalls: Traders lay boards together. The lane stays muddy, but small stalls can open without an electricity bill.
district.silver: Silver paint glints under the bridge lamp. The performer stops for water and waits for a train to pass. “Dry lanes bring visitors. Working lights let us get home safely.”
district.busker: A small drum answers the sound of passing trains. The musician waits for the traders to decide about the water.
district.pump.intro: The pump cable feeds from the market lights. Bu Nira knows another option.
district.pump.drain: The water recedes. The market lights dim because the pump uses the shared power.
district.pump.stalls: The walking boards reach every stall. The pump stays off.
district.busker.drain: The lane is dry, but the evening lights are dim. The musician moves closer to the food stall.
district.busker.stalls: The walking boards bring the audience back. Music accompanies the traders as they open.
district.toast.drain: The water recedes, but the market lights dim.
district.toast.stalls: Walking boards are laid; traders share two herbal remedies.
district.toast.snack: The meal is shared. Conscious teammates recover 20% HP.
audio.koplo: Travel melodies meet hand drum beats and koplo rhythms. Music changes as you explore, enter buildings, and battle.

gang.arrive: Gang Senggol (Senggol Alley): meet Mbak Reka near the warung.

gang.watch.open: The sign towards Hutan Pinggir Kota is visible from the alley. All routes are free to use.
gang.watch.map: The map leads past the stall, right to the Pos Ronda, then along the alley to Bang Jali. Bring the directions so the northern path can be marked for everyone.
gang.guide.community: The sign is up. Residents can easily find Hutan Pinggir Kota to the north and Sukamaju to the west.
gang.guide.paid: The directions have been recorded. All routes are free to use, but the public sign is still missing.
gang.guide.offer: This alley is free to walk through. Hutan Pinggir Kota is to the north, Sukamaju to the west. Official fee: Rp0. If you want to help, we can put up a sign with the residents, or you can pay an unofficial Rp25.000 coordination fee to record the directions.
gang.guide.sign: Put up the public sign, free
gang.guide.needReka: Meet Mbak Reka near the warung first.
gang.guide.needMap: Get the map from the Pos Ronda first.
gang.guide.ready: The map and sign are ready.
gang.reka.paid: The northern route is open to you, but other residents still get lost. The public sign is missing.
gang.reka.community: Schoolchildren can easily find the way to Hutan Pinggir Kota without paying anyone.
gang.reka.ask: All routes are already free to use. I have the sign. Pick up the map at the Pos Ronda, then meet Bang Jali. We can mark the way to Hutan Pinggir Kota and Sukamaju so residents do not get lost.

text.017: Collect Bu Sari’s supplies and battle Maundur Ayunan and Baem Parkiran.
text.022: Help two volunteers, share out six units of water in the laboratory, then challenge Sisilaut. Rajapari arrives after the badge; catching it is optional.
text.023: Nine badges bring you to the League qualifying route. Beyond the caldera, the old observatory sends out the same signal every night. Two hikers help keep the path safe.
text.024: Register for one run: the Elite Four, then the Champion. HP and supplies carry over between matches. Leaving the region or giving up restarts the run.

gate.leader.17.trainer: This arena has an order. {names} are still waiting on the practice courts. Beat them first, then we meet in the final.
gate.leader.26.trainer: This stage isn't lit yet, and my crew hasn't seen your team. {names} are waiting on the plaza. Help them first, then we'll sing together up here.
gate.leader.26.task: The lights are still out. Without all nine lamps lit, nobody can see our match. The power panel is beside the stage.
gate.leader.29.trainer: We can't serve yet. {names} are still training on the pier. Beat them first, then step onto my court.
gate.leader.29.task: The sanctuary's water hasn't been shared out. Until the valves are balanced I can't play with a clear head. Sort out the console in the lab first.
gate.leader.32.trainer: The sky isn't ready to be counted. {names} on the mountain trail are still waiting for your challenge.
gate.leader.32.task: The telescope isn't calibrated. We'll battle once the orbit signal reads clearly.
gate.leader.34.trainer: It's not time for us to face each other. {names} is still waiting on the platform. Prove you can beat them first.
gate.leader.34.task: My train can't reach Platform 2 yet. Connect the rails at the switch panel, then we'll talk about a match.
gate.leader.36.trainer: My kitchen isn't open for challenges. Beat {names} first, my fussiest cook.
gate.leader.36.task: Customers are still waiting for their orders. Deliver everything from the delivery kitchen first, then come back.
gate.leader.38.trainer: The workshop isn't ready for visitors. {names} still wants to test your team.
gate.leader.38.task: The service gears aren't turning. Fix the service panel first, then I'll open the arena.
gate.leader.40.trainer: The park hasn't recovered. {names} is still waiting for you by the irrigation panel.
gate.leader.40.task: The water isn't reaching every channel. Fix the irrigation panel, then we'll battle by the reservoir.
gate.leader.42.trainer: {names} guards this climb first. Beat them, and the path to the caldera rim opens for you.
gate.device.5: This panel is still live. Battle me first. If your team stays calm under pressure, I'll let you touch it.
gate.device.6: The sanctuary valves aren't toys. Beat me first so I know you'll share the water fairly.
gate.device.7: This telescope is very sensitive. Show me your team is patient enough. Battle me.
gate.device.8: This switch moves real rails. I need to see how you lead a team first. Let's battle!
gate.device.9: Customers' orders can't go astray. Battle me first, then I'll hand you the delivery box.
gate.device.10: These service gears can pinch fingers. Battle me first so I know you're nimble.
gate.device.11: These pipes water the whole park. Beat me first, then I'll trust you to look after them.
pitstop.offer: Your team looks worn out. Let me check them one by one: joint oil, batteries, loose bolts. Half an hour and they are done.
pitstop.fine: Everything runs smoothly. Nothing needs servicing today.
pitstop.done: Service done. Full HP and every condition cleared.
food.warung.title: Kaldera Coffee Stall
food.warung.intro: “What’ll it be, Kak? Prices are on the board.”
food.warung.result: Team fullness rises by {fill}. HP and conditions stay the same.
food.warung.spirit: “Keep going! The summit is almost there.” Free, and your team smiles.
daycare.away.none: You have not left any companions at the daycare. Daycare staff work at Pos RT, the minimarkets and the clinics; leave companions there when your team is full.
warung.tea.button: Warm tea, restore team HP · Rp1.000
warung.tea.reviveButton: Warm tea, revive & heal team · Rp1.000
warung.tea.hint: Warm tea at Warung Bu Sari restores the whole team’s HP, including fainted Wargamon (Rp1.000). Conditions and fullness remain unchanged.
warung.tea.title: Bu Sari’s Warung
warung.tea.greeting: Take a moment to rest. My warm tea can restore your whole team’s HP.
trainer.7.name: Kevantul Senjaya
trainer.8.name: Lilincah Natsirup
trainer.17.name: Joko Widuduk
trainer.48.name: Prabu Wibawa
guide.050: The sensor measures water clarity. Use the valve console to distribute water to the sanctuary channels.
guide.051: Coral samples help researchers check the sanctuary. Balanced channels protect the home of sea Wargamon.
world.chapter.travel: Four areas in each chapter. Travel between chapters through connectors.
world.connector.name: Connector: {chapter}
debug.editor.title: Walkable area editor
debug.editor.help: Drag a box to paint it. Green = walkable; orange = too narrow (a path needs to be 3 cells wide). X swaps green ↔ grey (right button = the other colour). Zoom: + / − or Ctrl+scroll. Move around: arrows / WASD, two-finger scroll, or Space+drag. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes.
debug.editor.canvas: Walkable areas; drag a box to paint it
debug.editor.saved: Draft saved in this browser. Click Save permanently to apply this map to the project.
debug.editor.projectSaved: Saved permanently to the project. This map applies to all players after reloading.
debug.editor.projectFailed: Permanent save failed. Your draft remains in this browser; try again.
debug.editor.projectConflict: Project data changed. Reload before saving; your draft is still saved.
debug.editor.serverNeeded: Draft saved in this browser. For permanent saves, use the local editor server (npm run dev).
debug.editor.unsaved: Browser storage failed. Click Save permanently before closing the editor.
chapter2.market.name: Pasar Rakyat
chapter2.civic.name: Balai Beton
chapter2.mall.name: Wargamall
chapter2.market.dockwild: Wild Wargamon in the dock waters
chapter2.market.foodwild: Wild Wargamon by the food stalls
chapter2.civic.gardenwild: Wild Wargamon by the civic garden
battle.fainted.title: All Wargamon have fainted
battle.fainted.body: All your Wargamon stay at 0 HP. You remain where the battle ended and walk alone. Visit a food stall, rest stop, or HP recovery service to restore your team.
battle.fainted.recover: Your team has fainted. Visit a food stall or rest stop to restore HP.
battle.fainted.hint: Walking alone; your team needs recovery. M: map, E: interact
ojek.chat.challengers: The kids at the stand loved Bu Sari’s food. {n} challengers are still out in the meadow; the forest is only safe once you’ve beaten them.
ojek.chat.clear: The meadow is quiet now, every challenger beaten. The footpath to the forest is on the east side of the meadow. Take care, and don’t litter in there.
dine.title: Eat here
dine.body: {dish}. The whole team recovers its HP and Fullness, fainted teammates included. Conditions such as Poison stay; treat them at a clinic.
dine.full: The team is already full and at full HP
dine.done: {dish} finished. Team HP and Fullness restored.
dine.dish.rice: Nasi rames with tempeh and vegetables
heal.free: You're short on money, so this one's on the house. Pay next time!
battle.xp: {n} XP for {name}, and the team trains too
battle.xp.catchUp: teammates who fell behind get 2× XP
dex.milestone.20: Wargadex: 20 species! Gift: 5 Rantau Capsules and 2 Ultra Capsules.
dex.milestone.40: Wargadex: 40 species! Gift: 5 Ultra Capsules and 3 Strong Jamu.
dex.milestone.60: Wargadex: 60 species! Gift: 5 Ultra Capsules, a Spirit Scarf and a Guard Vest.
dex.milestone.80: Wargadex complete! Collector's Card: rare finds are now twice as common.
ojek.ride.done: The ride-hail drops you at {place}. Fare {fare}.
dine.special.body: Special: HP and Fullness restored, plus {effect} for 3 battles.
trainer.49.name: Belerani Kawahsari
trainer.49.line: The crater wind changes every hour. If you can read the heat, you may walk past with your head held high.
trainer.49.win: You read the crater faster than I do. Mind your step on the slope.
trainer.50.name: Okular Bimasakti
trainer.50.line: I'm staying up for a clear sky. While we wait, let's battle under the dome.
trainer.50.win: Even the stars shine less brightly than your team tonight.
trainer.51.name: Mudika Rindurumah
trainer.51.role: Home for mudik (the holiday trip home)
trainer.51.line: We grew up in the same alley. I left for the city, you became Champion. Now prove it here in our own kampung!
trainer.51.win: My souvenir for you: respect. You really are the Champion. Mbah Sepuh is waiting for you at Padang Ojek.
trainer.52.name: Mbah Sepuh Jagadlawas
trainer.52.line: I brought the very first League trophy home to this field. Show Mbah what a Champion means in your day.
trainer.52.win: Ha! This kampung has a Champion again. Take the Mudik Cup home, Nak.
mudik.intro.title: Pulang kampung: home to the kampung, Champion!
mudik.intro.body: News of your title has reached Sukamaju. The Wargamon in the fields and forest grew up while you were away. Careful: the mudik (holiday homecoming) road is bound to be jammed. {rival}, a friend from the kampung who left for the city, waits on the road near the Pos RT, and {master} wants to meet you at Padang Ojek.
mudik.objective.title: Mudik: battle {name}.
mudik.objective.rival: Your old friend waits on the street by Pos RT, Sukamaju.
mudik.objective.master: The first League Champion waits at the Padang Ojek crossroads.
mudik.cup.title: The Mudik Cup!
mudik.cup.body: Reward: Rp100.000, 5 Ultra Capsules and 3 Strong Jamu. Your home kampung has a Champion again.
mudik.salam: Before you go, Mbah presses a salam tempel envelope into your hand: {money}. “Maaf lahir batin, forgive me, Nak. Don’t forget to come home.”
mudik.macet.title: Macet: a jam on the mudik road!
mudik.macet.body: The road home is gridlocked. Motorbikes, angkot and vehicle Wargamon jostle while horns blare. Help clear the jam: 3 battles in a row, with no healing in between.
mudik.macet.fight: Jam {n}/{total}: {name} barges between the homebound cars!
mudik.macet.next.title: Still jammed
mudik.macet.next.body: Homebound drivers wind down their windows and cheer your team. {n} more before the road clears.
mudik.macet.stopped: You pull over for now. The jam is still waiting on the mudik road.
mudik.lebaran.title: Lebaran in the kampung
mudik.lebaran.body: The road is clear again. At home, Bu Sari has ketupat (rice cakes) and opor ayam (chicken in coconut sauce) ready, and the neighbours keep dropping by to shake hands.
mudik.lebaran.maaf: Mohon maaf lahir dan batin, Nak: forgive us, body and soul. You’re home at last.
mudik.lebaran.reward: Pak RT slips you THR (holiday money): {thr}. The team eats opor: full HP and Fullness, {effect} for 3 battles.
bazaar.open: See the dawn market's rare goods
bazaar.title: Rare goods stall
bazaar.intro: “The goods change every day. What isn't here today might arrive tomorrow.”
bazaar.dawn: Still subuh (dawn)! Until seven, Bu Nira lays out all three of her goods at once.
bazaar.dawnLater: Come between 04:00 and 07:00 to see every good at once.
bazaar.guest.title: Today’s visiting trader
bazaar.guest.uda.name: Uda Rizal, from Minangkabau
bazaar.guest.uda.greet: “Singgahlah dulu, Kak, do stop by! This rendang is fresh off the wok, lamak bana, delicious!”
bazaar.guest.uda.thanks: “Tarimo kasih, Kak! Eat plenty!” The rendang is gone, and the team feels stronger.
bazaar.guest.daeng.name: Daeng Baso, from Makassar
bazaar.guest.daeng.greet: “Apa kareba, Kak, how are you? The coto Makassar is still piping hot, really good!”
bazaar.guest.daeng.thanks: “Makasih, di’! That broth toughens you up.” The team is full and hard to knock down.
bazaar.guest.mace.name: Mace Yosina, from Papua
bazaar.guest.mace.greet: “Selamat pagi, Kaka, good morning! Papeda with yellow fish soup, I made it myself. Come and eat!”
bazaar.guest.mace.thanks: “Terima kasih banyak, Kaka! Eat slowly, eh.” The team’s eyes are sharp now.
bazaar.guest.bli.name: Bli Komang, from Bali
bazaar.guest.bli.greet: “Om Swastiastu, Kak! Canang sari, a little offering of flowers and prayers for lucky throws.”
bazaar.guest.bli.thanks: “Suksma, Kak, thank you! Good luck.” The canang sari watches over your capsule throws.
bazaar.guest.meal: HP and Fullness restored on the spot, plus {effect} for {n} battles.
bazaar.guest.canang: +10% catch chance for the next 5 capsule throws.
bazaar.guest.next: One guest good a day. Tomorrow: {name}.
bazaar.bought: {name} is in your bag. Use it from Team & Bag.
bazaar.lantern.name: Lantern Charm
bazaar.lantern.desc: Rare finds twice as common for 30 wild encounters.
bazaar.lantern.used: The Lantern Charm glows. Rare finds are more common!
bazaar.basket.name: Pandan Basket
bazaar.basket.desc: +10% catch chance for the next 5 capsule throws.
bazaar.basket.used: The Pandan Basket is ready. Your next throws are steadier.
bazaar.honey.name: Batik Honey
bazaar.honey.desc: Every conscious teammate recovers 50% HP, and Fullness is full.
bazaar.honey.used: The Batik Honey is shared. The team feels fresh again.
delivery.title: Delivery runs
delivery.intro: Take orders to shops in the city within {steps} steps. The first {full} runs each day pay in full; every third full-pay run earns a bonus Ultra Capsule. Sometimes a challenger blocks the route.
delivery.today: Today {n}/{full} full-pay runs. {total} runs in total.
delivery.taken: {item} for {shop}, {place}. Hurry before it gets cold!
delivery.cold: The order went cold. Take a new one at the Delivery Kitchen.
delivery.done.title: Order delivered!
ronda.day: “The ronda (night watch) starts at ten at night, when the kentongan (slit drum) sounds. Come back later.”
ronda.early: “It’s early yet, Dik. The ronda starts at ten. Have a coffee while you wait; the gorengan (fritters) are still warm.”
ronda.done: “Tonight's watch is done. Thank you, get some rest.”
ronda.offer: “Join the ronda (night watch)? We patrol the alley and face {n} night Wargamon in a row. Finish it for pay and a Lantern Charm.”
ronda.fight: Tong-tong-tong! Ronda {n}/{total}: {name} appears out of the dark!
ronda.guest: Ronda {n}/{total}: a rare guest! {name} drops by the pos, lured by the smell of coffee.
ronda.next.title: The watch goes on
ronda.next.body: {n} more to go. Pak Hansip pours kopi and passes round gorengan: the team recovers 10% HP.
ronda.pantun.title: Pak Hansip’s pantun (a rhyming quatrain):
ronda.pantun.0:
Off to market for shrimp paste,
home along the river bend.
On the ronda, no time to waste,
eyes wide open till night’s end!
ronda.pantun.1:
Fried banana, piping hot,
black coffee, no sugar, please.
Wargamon coming? Worry not,
together we’ll handle these!
ronda.pantun.2:
Snake fruit, hog plums, by the score,
Mum bought them at the dawn bazaar.
The kentongan’s struck once more,
round the alley, near and far!
ronda.pantun.3:
Strolling round the old town square,
don’t forget to buy some bread.
The alley’s safe now, everywhere,
thanks to your kind heart, Pak said.
ronda.stopped: The watch is called off. Try again another night.
ronda.reward.title: Watch complete!
ronda.reward.body: “Tong, tong, tong. The alley is safe tonight.” Pay {pay}, 2 Ultra Capsules and 1 Lantern Charm.
delivery.ambush.9: Oi, another courier? Whose parcel is that? Battle me first; the loser walks behind!
delivery.ambush.2: Is that a promo order? I’ve been queueing for ages! Battle me first, then you can pass.
delivery.ambush.11: My angkot is parked right across your path. Want to get by? Battle me first, for fun.
delivery.ambush.offer: Win, and the shop adds a {tip} tip. You can also just walk on; your order stays warm.
delivery.ambush.passed: “Aw, no fun.” You carry on with the delivery.
delivery.ambush.won: Your challenger steps aside. Deliver the order for a {tip} tip!
delivery.ambush.tip: Tip for winning on the way: {tip}.
arisan.title: Arisan Dapur (kitchen savings circle)
arisan.offer: Join the arisan, a savings circle with a weekly draw? Each full-pay delivery puts in {fee}. Pay in {need} times in a week to join next Monday’s kocokan (draw).
arisan.joined: Your name is on the arisan list. The draw is every Monday!
arisan.turnNow: This week the pot is yours to draw!
arisan.paid: Arisan dues of {fee} set aside. Paid in this week: {n}/{need}.
arisan.won: Arisan draw: your name came out! You get 3 Ultra Capsules, 1 Batik Honey and 1 Pandan Basket. The kitchen cheers.
arisan.other: The arisan draw went to {name}. You share the snacks and get 2 Jamu.
opening.partner.title: Catch a second Wargamon (0/1).
opening.partner.detail: The bushes behind Dapur MBG are full of wild Wargamon. Sukamaju's locals battle with two, so a second teammate helps a lot.
wait.night.done: The sun sets. Night Wargamon come out, and the Pos Ronda opens.
wait.day.done: Morning comes. The kampung bustles again.
wait.ronda.done: Tong-tong-tong! The kentongan sounds: ten at night, the ronda begins.
resident.100.0: The bushes behind Dapur MBG are full of Wargamon. Catch a second teammate before you challenge the locals.
resident.100.1: Dapur MBG serves free meals. A well-fed Wargamon hits harder.
resident.100.2: That futsal pitch isn't just decoration. Try a penalty shoot-out when you have time.
resident.100.3: Veggies, fresh veggies! Oops, force of habit. Yesterday Bu RT haggled over kangkung so hard I nearly lost money.
resident.100.name: Pak Darmo, travelling vegetable seller
resident.101.0: Tired of walking? Open the map and book an Ojek Online ride to any place you've visited.
resident.101.1: Different Wargamon come out at night. If you can't wait, rest and wait until night.
resident.101.2: Every area has its own signature Wargamon. The one here loves to ride.
resident.101.3: My last passenger wanted me to speed, then asked to stop for cilok. Ya ampun, make up your mind!
resident.101.name: Mbak Sinta, ojek driver
resident.102.0: Sometimes a Wargamon appears in strange colours. It's very rare, so treasure it if you find one.
resident.102.1: At night there's a green glow in the bushes. That's Mangglow, which only comes out after dark.
resident.102.2: They say a wild Muspandan lives at the reservoir park. Very rare, but it's no fairy tale.
resident.102.3: Kakek used to climb honey trees without a rope. These days my knees complain about the stairs at home.
resident.102.name: Kakek Rimba, honey gatherer
resident.103.0: Pak Hansip at the Pos Ronda needs company on the night watch. Come at night, the pay is decent!
resident.103.1: If it's still daytime, rest on a bench and wait until night.
resident.103.2: These alleys twist and turn. Follow Bang Jali's signs so you don't get lost.
resident.103.3: Kak, my kite got stuck on the power line again. Don’t tell Mum, okay?
resident.103.name: Dik Ucup, alley kid
resident.104.0: Rare goods are sold at Pasar Subuh, through the Wargamall atrium. The stock changes every day.
resident.104.1: Bu Nira's Batik Honey refreshes the whole team at once.
resident.104.2: Jamu is cheap, but a warung meal fills you up more. Choose for your journey.
resident.104.3: Beras kencur, Kak? A little bitter, but not as bitter as being dumped when you’re head over heels.
resident.104.name: Bu Tini, jamu seller
resident.105.0: The Wargadex isn't just a list. Every 20 species earns a gift from the organisers.
resident.105.1: Wargamon you've met are recorded, even if you haven't caught them.
resident.105.2: Arena Beton waits inside the hall. Bring a team with a mix of types.
resident.105.3: This hall has thirty keys. Only two get used. What do the rest open? Nobody remembers, Dik.
resident.105.name: Pak Joni, town-hall guard
resident.106.0: Warungs have a special menu. Rendang makes attacks stronger for three battles.
resident.106.1: Tired of waiting for animations? The Menu has a 2× battle speed option.
resident.106.2: The stage only lights up once all the festival power is connected.
resident.106.3: I left my costume on the angkot. Am I meant to dance in a house dress? Hey, don’t laugh!
resident.106.name: Kak Lala, festival dancer
resident.107.0: The Delivery Kitchen in the atrium always needs couriers. Deliver fast; the pay grows as your journey goes on.
resident.107.1: Kak Rena by the fountain can teach new moves.
resident.107.2: One parcel, one shop. Don't let the order go cold.
resident.107.3: The address just says “green house next to the mango tree”. Every house here looks like that, Kak!
resident.107.name: Mas Andi, freelance courier
resident.108.0: Sometimes there's a Galomang in the water by the pier. It's rare, so be patient.
resident.108.1: Rajapari guards this sanctuary. Respect the sea and it will repay you.
resident.108.2: If your team is tired, eat at a warung first. Even fishermen don't sail on an empty stomach.
resident.108.3: Small fish today, but my stories are still big. Want to hear about the shark the size of a boat?
resident.108.name: Pak Udin, fisherman
resident.109.0: Trains come every hour, but an ojek is faster to places you've already visited.
resident.109.1: The switch panel on the platform must be connected before the staff will battle.
resident.109.2: The station is quiet at night. That's when night Wargamon wander.
resident.109.3: The train runs on time; the passengers run late. Every day someone sprints in clutching a rantang (lunch tin).
resident.109.name: Bu Ratna, train driver
resident.110.0: Flat tyre? I patch it. Leaky team? Give them gear, Kak. A Spirit Scarf or a Guard Vest, mantap jiwa (rock solid).
resident.110.1: Pak Tono at the workshop can patch up your team, like a clinic.
resident.110.2: Service machine jammed? Turn the gears until they fit.
resident.110.3: A customer’s motorbike has been here a month. He keeps saying “I’ll collect it tomorrow”. Which tomorrow, boss?
resident.110.name: Om Tejo, mechanic
resident.111.0: Sometimes a Muspandan hides in the plants by the reservoir. Nenek saw one once.
resident.111.1: At night the reservoir sparkles. Lumilaut comes out of the water.
resident.111.2: Water flowing the right way keeps this park alive. Help set the channels.
resident.111.3: My grandson works in the city and only calls at Lebaran. Don’t do that to your own nenek, all right?
resident.111.name: Nenek Teratai
resident.112.0: Jalakawatt sometimes perches on this peak. A rare bird with a strong aura.
resident.112.1: Wifilawar loves a strong signal. This peak is its home.
resident.112.2: Take the climb slowly. Rest at the hikers' stop before going on.
resident.112.3: They say the signal up here is strong. Strong enough for my boss to tell me off on a video call.
resident.112.name: Bang Riko, hiker
resident.113.0: A wild Cabrawit was once seen on the warm slope. It's rare, but I'm sure I saw it.
resident.113.1: The coffee here sharpens your aim. Try the special menu at the kiosk.
resident.113.2: Bu Ramu on this trail teaches moves. Bring enough money.
resident.113.3: The climbers’ coffee tab fills two pages of my book. Want to settle it? Wani piro, how much have you got? Hehe.
resident.113.name: Bu Kawah, warung owner
resident.114.0: Sun, moon, stars. The panels must be aligned to wake the dome's guardian.
resident.114.1: They say the League Champion is invited home to Sukamaju for mudik. Someone is waiting there!
resident.114.2: From this dome, the night sky looks so clear.
resident.114.3: My physics homework is about stars. I just wrote “stars are pretty”. What mark do you reckon I’ll get, Kak?
resident.114.name: Dik Bintang, student
resident.115.0: League rules: HP carries over between matches, no free healing. Stock up on jamu first, and no crying halfway through.
resident.115.1: The co-op closes during the League. Shop first!
resident.115.2: Once you’re Champion, go home to Sukamaju. Your home kampung has a surprise.
resident.115.3: Every year someone protests my calls. Last year it was my own cat. Patience, patience.
resident.115.name: Pak Wasit, League official

battle.tips.title: How battles work
battle.tips.tempo: Tempo (the yellow dots) grows with light moves or Brace, and powers strong moves.
battle.tips.matchup: The ×1.6 on a move card means super effective against this foe; ×0.7 means not very effective.
battle.tips.brace: Brace adds Tempo and cuts the next hit by more than half.
battle.tips.keys: Keyboard keys are printed on every button: 1–5 moves, B Brace, C Catch, S Switch, I Item, R Run, X Speed.
dex.unknown: Not met yet. Meet this Wargamon in the wild or in a match to record it.
journal.ronda.day: Ronda (night watch): starts at 22:00 at the Pos Ronda, Gang Senggol (or wait for night at a rest bench).
journal.ronda.open: Ronda (night watch): open now at the Pos Ronda, Gang Senggol.
journal.guest: Visiting trader at the Pasar Subuh today: {name}.
journal.agustus: Lomba 17-an (Independence Day contests) on the Sukamaju pitch: the penalty shoot-out for the Piala Agustusan, panjat pinang (greasy pole), balap karung (sack race) and makan kerupuk (cracker-eating).
journal.delivery: Delivery runs today: {n}/{full} at full pay.
hint.touch: {name} follows you. Tap the map to walk, INTERACT to talk.
place.gang.subtitle: Alleys and neighbourhood stories
objective.league.enterArena: Enter the League building using the north steps, then register at the arena desk.
objective.finished.title: The main story is complete. You hold the Concrete Badge.
objective.finished.detail: If you like, try the penalty shootout on the Sukamaju pitch, meet challengers on other routes, or complete the Wargadex.
objective.parcel.title: Collect supplies from Bu Sari.
objective.parcel.detail: Enter Warung Bu Sari in Sukamaju, then talk to her.
objective.sukamaju.trainer.title: Battle {name}.
objective.sukamaju.trainer.detail: Meet the four Sukamaju challengers before asking for a travel permit.
objective.sukamaju.permit.title: Ask Pak RT for a travel permit.
objective.sukamaju.permit.detail: Pak RT (the neighbourhood head) waits behind the desk in the Pos RT. Go on in; he’s ready to sign.
objective.ojek.delivery.title: Deliver the supplies to the ojek stand.
objective.ojek.delivery.detail: Talk to the Pos Ojek attendant in Padang Ojek.
objective.ojek.trainer.title: Get past {name}’s challenge.
objective.ojek.trainer.detail: Win to open the route to the forest.
objective.forest.trash.title: Clear the forest route: {n}/3 bags.
objective.forest.trash.detail: Follow the visible cream-coloured path. The pond and areas off the path cannot be crossed.
objective.market.stampSri.title: Ask Bu Sri for a stamp at Pasar Rakyat.
objective.market.stampSri.detail: Collect two stamps from the locals, then battle Iqbol by the southern stalls.
objective.market.stampImah.title: Collect Bu Imah’s stamp inside the market hall.
objective.market.stampImah.detail: Enter Pasar Rakyat, then speak with Bu Imah on the left side of the hall.
objective.market.seen.title: Meet at least three basic Wargamon species.
objective.market.seen.detail: Collection so far: {n}/3. Catch a species you do not have yet.
objective.market.ticket.title: Exchange your stamps for a travel card.
objective.market.ticket.detail: Meet Pak Darto at the travel desk inside the Pasar Rakyat hall.
objective.market.iqbol.title: Meet Iqbol by the southern market stalls.
objective.market.iqbol.detail: Your card is ready. Win this match before the test at Balai Beton.
objective.beton.trainer.title: Arena Beton: defeat {name}.
objective.beton.trainer.detail: Enter the gym and complete the four qualifying matches.
objective.beton.final.title: Final: defeat Joko Widuduk.
objective.beton.final.detail: Joko waits at the back of the Balai Beton hall. After winning the badge, continue to Festival Arus.
objective.badgeFrom.title: Win the {badge} from {name}.
objective.badgeFrom.detail: The locals' task is done. Prepare your team, then enter the arena.
objective.legend.rajapari.title: Optional: meet Rajapari at the sanctuary pier.
objective.legend.rajapari.detail: Story complete! You can try the legend again if you lose or flee. Team full? The catch goes to Daycare.
objective.legend.jalakawatt.title: Optional: meet Jalakawatt at the mountain substation.
objective.legend.jalakawatt.detail: Story complete! Lower its HP and inflict a condition before throwing a capsule.
objective.chaptersDone.title: All chapters complete: four badges and the sanctuary legend!
objective.chaptersDone.detail: Explore again, arrange your team, or try the penalty shootout on the Sukamaju pitch.
objective.delivery.title: Deliver {item} to {name}.
objective.rail.title: Connect the rails to Platform 2.
objective.dispatch.title: Pick up the order at the delivery kitchen.
objective.station.badge.detail: The region’s challenges are done. Prepare your team and approach the arena.
objective.sixBadges.title: Six badges earned!
objective.sixBadges.detail: Collect 38 forms, raise Satecil to Lv.36, or rematch.
objective.badge.title: Claim the {badge}.
objective.nineBadges.title: Nine badges earned!
objective.nineBadges.detail: Collect 42 forms or try a new team lineup.
objective.league.challenge: Challenge the Elite Four and Champion.
objective.league.active: HP carries over. Use supplies from Team & Bag, then continue the match.
objective.league.prepare: Prepare six companions and supplies. Register in the League courtyard.
objective.tarsion.title: Eyes Behind the Dome, {step}.
objective.tarsion.open: Tarsion waits in the courtyard. Lower its HP and inflict a condition; one capture per trip.
objective.tarsion.started: Sun to the East; Moon opposite; Star one step clockwise from the Moon.
objective.tarsion.return: An optional quest to befriend the observatory’s guardian.
objective.champion.title: League Champion and friend of Tarsion!
objective.champion.detail: Visit the Hall of Champions, collect all {n} forms, or replay the League against stronger opponents.
battle.log.sleepGuard: {name} is still wide awake and does not fall asleep.
battle.log.whistle: {name} was startled by the whistle! Turn skipped.

move.desc.mark: apply Sugar: bonus damage on the next Fire/Electric hit

move.effect.slow: Heavy: lands after the foe acts.
battle.tips.heavy: Tempo −2 moves are heavy: the foe acts first, then yours lands. When the foe hits hard, switching can be safer.
battle.log.miss: {name}: {move} missed! Tempo and cooldown are still spent.
battle.log.shell: A shield is ready to absorb one hit.
battle.log.teamHeal: The team recovered {n} HP in total.
battle.log.teamWard: Each team member is protected from one condition.
battle.log.sugar: Sugar sticks: follow up with Fire or Electric!

move.effect.recoil: The user loses HP equal to {n}% of damage dealt.

move.effect.pierce: Bypasses the opponent’s type resistance and reflection.

move.effect.wetBonus: Deals 25% extra damage to a Soaked opponent.
