battle.log.enemyBrace: {name} braces: building Tempo and absorbing the hit.
trainer.potions: Jamu in the bag: {n}, given when a creature is nearly down.
trainer.style.status: Style: opens with conditions and team support.
trainer.style.guard: Style: shields, heals and braces when pressed.
trainer.style.aggressive: Style: all-out attacks with the strongest moves.
battle.fainted.fee: While you carry your team away, {fee} slips out of your pocket.
battle.log.capsuleOpened: The capsule opened. Lower its HP and inflict a condition.
battle.toast.needTempo: Build Tempo with a light move or Brace.
battle.log.brace: Braced: +1 Tempo, next accuracy +12%, next incoming hit reduced by 55%.
battle.toast.ran: Returned to your starting position. Conditions remain.
battle.toast.cooling: That move is cooling down. Choose another move.
league.champion.title: Nusantara League Champion!
league.champion.trophy: {name} hands you the trophy. The people of Sukamaju fill the stands: the journey that began with Bu Sari’s supplies is now recorded in the Hall of Champions.
league.champion.reward: Champion reward: Rp30.000. Researchers report that Tarsion recognises your team's signal. Return to the observatory for
quest.tarsion.name: Eyes Behind the Dome
battle.win.wild: Victory! The whole team gains XP.
battle.victory.gateOpen: +{reward}. Everything this area asks for is done. The next gate is open!
badge.win.26.title: The festival lights up again!
badge.win.29.title: The sanctuary breathes again!
badge.win.32.title: The sky can be read again!
badge.win.supplies: The whole team is fully healed. Travel supplies: 5 capsules, 2 Ultra Capsules, 5 jamu and 2 Strong Jamu.
badge.win.26.next: The stage lights are back. Continue to the Wargamall atrium for food deliveries and the Taste Arena.
badge.win.29.next: Rajapari appears at the sanctuary pier. Catching it is optional; the mountain route is already open.
badge.win.32.next: All four badges earned! The route to Stasiun Sela is open east of the mountain. Jalakawatt still waits at the substation.
badge.win.findLegend: Go on to find the legend
badge.win.34.title: Platform Badge!
badge.win.36.title: Flavour Badge!
badge.win.34.next: The Water & Parks chapter continues along the open routes.
badge.win.36.next: Complete every activity in the City Centre chapter, then use the Pasar Rakyat dock connector to Pesisir Suaka.
item.balls.name: Rantau Capsule
item.ultraballs.name: Ultra Capsule
item.potions.name: Jamu
item.potions.desc: Restores 30% HP, at least 40; conditions stay.
item.antidotes.name: Antidote
item.maxpotion.name: Strong Jamu
item.maxpotion.desc: Fully heal one conscious teammate; conditions remain.
item.revive.name: Revival Balm
item.revive.desc: Revive one fainted teammate with 50% HP.
item.ultraballs.desc: Better capture chance; weaken the opponent first.
item.scarf.name: Spirit Scarf
item.scarf.desc: Deal 12% more damage; take 10% more damage.
item.vest.name: Guard Vest
item.turbine.name: Industrial Dynamo
item.lunchbox.name: Warm Lunchbox
item.lunchbox.desc: Restore 5% HP each turn; deal 10% less damage.
item.sambal.name: Reckless Sambal
item.sambal.desc: Deal 25% more damage; lose 4% HP each turn.
item.coil.name: Mosquito Coil
item.coil.desc: Immune to Sleep; take 25% more Fire damage.
item.rescue.name: Rescue Charm
item.rescue.desc: Revive with 25% HP once per battle; deal 10% less damage.
item.capacitor.name: Imported Capacitor
item.capacitor.desc: Start with 3 Tempo; deal and take 15% more damage.
item.medkit.name: Imported Medkit
item.medkit.desc: Restore 5% HP each turn and block one status; deal 10% less damage.
item.umbrella.name: Folding Umbrella
item.umbrella.desc: Take 30% less Water damage and 25% more Electric damage.
equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.explainer: An item a Wargamon wears to help in battle.
equipment.oneEach: Each teammate can wear one item.
equipment.emptyHint: Choose an item from your bag to equip.
equipment.none: No gear in your bag yet. Look for it at kiosks along the way.
daycare.keepOneAwake: Keep at least one conscious companion.
daycare.keepOneConscious: Keep at least one conscious teammate.
rest.done: Rest complete. HP full; conditions remain.
daycare.title: Wargamon Daycare
daycare.away.count: {n} companions are waiting at the daycare. Daycare staff work at Pos RT, the minimarkets and the clinics; drop off or pick up companions there.
daycare.summary: Team {n}/6, Daycare {stored}. HP and conditions do not change.
daycare.swap.title: Swap {name}
daycare.swap.pick: Choose the active Wargamon to send to daycare.
trainer.reserve: Against a full team of six Wargamon, they send one reserve.
tutor.freeWarn.title: Replace the only free move?
tutor.freeWarn.body: {old} is {name}'s only move that costs no Tempo. With {move} in its place, {name} has to Brace whenever its Tempo runs out.
research.note.title: Research Notes
research.note.body: The laboratory ran out of electricity credit before its funding arrived. Neighbours restarted the equipment with a workshop’s spare dynamo. Become Champion, then align the courtyard panels to free Tarsion.
civic.permit.sealed.title: Counter sealed
civic.permit.sealed.body: Pak Map's kiosk closed after your report. The co-op and minimarket remain open.
league.facilitiesClosed: Use supplies from your Bag. Facilities reopen when your League run ends.
league.clinicClosed: The clinic reopens after your League run.
spring.alreadyFull: Your bottles are already full from the pond.
spring.title: Forest Pond
spring.body: A hillside spring feeds this pond; the water is clear and cold. You steep betel leaves from the bank and fill two bottles of herbal jamu for the road.
spring.once: You only have bottles enough to fill once.
tea.fullHp: Your team's HP is full. No need to buy tea.
trash.countDone: Bags collected {n}/3, the terminal door is open
permit.notYet.title: Pak RT cannot sign yet
permit.notYet.body: Collect Bu Sari’s supplies and finish the matches in Sukamaju first. Still to do: {list}. No photocopy of your Wargamon’s ID needed.
permit.issued.title: Travel permit issued!
permit.issued.body: “One signature, no fees. Don't let Galomang eat the paperwork.” Head to Padang Ojek.
terminal.stamp.warungIntro: “Have you eaten? Good, here's your stamp.”
terminal.stamp.count: {n}/2 stamps collected. Once complete, visit the ticket desk.
board.title: Community information board
warung.firstVisit.title: Bu Sari’s Supplies
warung.firstVisit.greeting: I've packed the supplies for the ojek stand. Two jamu are for you. Find a second Wargamon first in the bushes behind Dapur MBG, because the locals here battle with two. Then battle the locals and ask for a travel letter inside Pos RT.
ojek.chat.title: Bang Ujang, ojek stand
ojek.parcel.title: Delivery received
ojek.parcel.received: Supplies received! Three capsules and two jamu for your journey. Beat the three challengers in the field before entering the forest.
terminal.ticket.title: Travel desk
terminal.ticket.needSeen: All stamps collected. Arena applicants must know at least three basic Wargamon species. Find companions in the forest or fields first.
route.notes.title: Route notes
quest.emergencyCapsule: You received one free emergency capsule.
ending.beton.eyebrow: CONCRETE BADGE, THE CROWDS CHAPTER CONTINUES
ending.beton.title: The Concrete Badge is yours!
ending.beton.invite: {name} hands you an invitation: “The festival south of the hall has lost power. The stage crew needs your help.”
ending.beton.next: Continue to Festival Arus, then finish Wargamall’s food deliveries. After completing this chapter, the Pasar Rakyat dock connects you to Pesisir Suaka.
power.title: Turn on every light
power.done: Power is restored. The stage is safe for the show.
power.help.before: Press a switch to toggle its light and the lights directly above, below, left, and right. All
power.progress: {n}/9 lit, {moves} presses. Progress is saved when you close the panel.
power.notes.body: From the starting position: press 1, then 5, then 9. Reset first if you have already made changes. There is no penalty for trying.
signal.doneBody: Three patterns linked to the weather satellite. Bachar Hitung is ready for the final challenge. Received 3 bonus capsules and 3 jamu.
signal.title: Follow the satellite pulses
signal.help.after: , then repeat the sequence. There is no time limit. A wrong direction only resets the current round.
signal.wrong: That direction does not match. Watch again; previous rounds are safe.
legend.locked.legendary: The sanctuary is not calm yet
legend.locked.19: Restore the current and earn the Tide Badge, then return here.
legend.locked.18: Open the route to Puncak Sinyal after earning the Tide Badge. Then return here.
legend.known.title: {name} already knows you
legend.known.body: This legendary can only be caught once.
legend.oncePerTrip: One per trip. You can try again if you flee or lose.
legend.notLegendary: Not a legendary. Can be caught again at the substation and rarely appears in mountain bushes.
legend.teamFull: Team full: the catch is sent to Daycare.
legend.buyCapsules: Buy capsules at the co-op first.
legend.loan: A volunteer lends you three capsules for research.
hud.wild.none: No wild encounters in this area.
hud.wild.hintRoom: Use the exit at the bottom of the room.
hud.wild.hint: Use Find wild Wargamon to walk to this area’s encounter spot.
hint.keys: {name} follows you, M: map, E: interact
hint.forest: The cream-coloured path is walkable. Click the path or a destination.
help.basics.walk.title: Walk
help.basics.walk.detail: Use WASD or arrow keys. You can also click the ground.
help.basics.talk.title: Talk & enter
help.basics.talk.detail: Click a person, door or stall. Or walk close and press E.
help.basics.map.title: Map · M
help.basics.map.detail: Click Map or press M to pick an area you have opened.
help.basics.team.title: Team & Bag · T
help.basics.team.detail: Click a teammate to view moves, use medicine or equip an item.
help.basics.guide.title: Journal · J
help.basics.guide.detail: Main goal, badges and today's activities. Pick Go to goal to walk there automatically.
help.basics.save.title: Save · Menu (O)
help.basics.save.detail: Open the Menu, then Save: there are 10 slots. Your journey also saves automatically.
help.basics.load.title: Load · Menu (O)
help.basics.load.detail: Open the Menu, then Load to continue from a save.
help.basics.new.title: New game · Menu (O)
help.basics.new.detail: Open the Menu, then New game to start over with a new team.
help.battle.light.title: Light move → +1 Tempo
help.battle.light.detail: Collect up to 3 Tempo to use heavy moves.
help.battle.heavy.title: Heavy move → spend Tempo
help.battle.heavy.detail: Check its Tempo cost and cooldown before choosing.
help.battle.brace.title: Brace → withstand a hit
help.battle.brace.detail: Reduce one hit by 55%, gain 1 Tempo and +12% accuracy for your next move.
help.battle.switch.title: Switch teammate → 1 turn
help.battle.switch.detail: Choose a teammate whose type beats your opponent.
help.battle.accuracy.title: Accuracy → chance to hit
help.battle.accuracy.detail: Moves can miss; Tempo and cooldown are still spent.
help.battle.level.title: Level → stronger
help.battle.level.detail: Level up to gain HP and stronger attacks.
help.health.hp.title: HP · battle energy
help.health.hp.detail: No HP → fainted. Medicine or rest restores HP.
help.health.fullness.title: Fullness · a full stomach
help.health.fullness.detail: Food restores Fullness. Each turn uses 3; below 25, attacks weaken by 15%.
help.health.condition.title: Conditions · sickness or effects
help.health.condition.detail: Poison, sleep and other conditions have their own effects. Antidotes or a clinic remove them.
help.recovery.canteen.title: Canteen / stall → Fullness
help.recovery.canteen.detail: Paid meals safely fill your stomach.
help.recovery.mbg.title: MBG → 100 Fullness
help.recovery.mbg.detail: Free. There is a 5% chance one teammate gets poisoned.
help.recovery.rest.title: Rest → full HP
help.recovery.rest.detail: Conditions and Fullness stay the same.
help.recovery.clinic.title: Clinic → treat conditions
help.recovery.clinic.detail: Treats every condition, including several at once.
help.recovery.jamu.title: Medicine → HP
help.recovery.jamu.detail: Use Team & Bag to give it to a conscious teammate.
help.recovery.antidote.title: Antidote → conditions
help.recovery.antidote.detail: Choose a sick teammate in Team & Bag.
strip.aria: Your team: tap to open Team & Bag
help.team.catch.title: Catch → weaken it first
help.team.catch.detail: In a wild fight, bring the foe's HP down to red, then press Catch (C) and pick a capsule.
help.team.odds.title: Odds → shown on the capsule
help.team.odds.detail: The lower the foe's HP, the better the odds. Ultra Capsules work far better on strong Wargamon.
help.team.size.title: Team → six at most
help.team.size.detail: A seventh Wargamon goes to the daycare. Collect or swap them at the Daycare from Team & Bag.
help.team.gear.title: Gear → one per teammate
help.team.gear.detail: Buy it at a shop, then equip it from Team & Bag. Foes can see your gear, and you see theirs.
help.team.moves.title: New moves → Lv.{early} and Lv.{late}
help.team.moves.detail: A teammate with three moves learns a fourth at Lv.{early}. At Lv.{late} every teammate gets a fifth move.
help.team.evolve.title: Evolution → level up
help.team.evolve.detail: Each family evolves at a set level: more HP and a new name. See the Evolution tab in the Wargadex.
battle.tips.weaken: Weaken it first: the lower its HP, the easier the catch.
battle.tips.capsule: Press Catch, then pick a capsule. The catch odds are shown on every capsule.
battle.tips.run: Don't want to fight? You can always run from a wild fight.
dex.milestone.10: Wargadex 10 species! Reward: 5 Travel Capsules and 3 Jamu.
dex.gift.title: Wargadex reward: {n} species!
upcoming.title: COMING UP
upcoming.agustus: 17 August games: 10–24 August on the Sukamaju pitch, {when}.
welcome.title: Long time no see! {n} days have passed.
welcome.trader: Visiting trader at the Pasar Subuh: {name}.
welcome.guest: Today's guest Wargamon: {name} in the {region} habitats.
welcome.ronda: Tonight's night watch starts at 22:00 at the Pos Ronda, Gang Senggol.
hint.find.touch: Something is here: tap Pick up find
menu.title: Journey menu
menu.fullscreen.unsupported: This browser does not support fullscreen.
types.title: Type Chart
types.aria: Arrows point to the type that has the advantage
types.footnote: Arrows point towards the weaker type. Reverse matchups: ×0.7. Dual types combine both matchups.
civic.savedNote: Your choice is saved and will have consequences in a later region.
civic.noSecondPayment: Your decision is saved. You will not be charged again here.
civic.broker.title: The broker returns
civic.broker.body: Your medicine arrived quickly, but Pak Map now wants Rp40.000. Pay to keep his kiosk available, or report him and use the cooperative.
civic.delivery.title: The delayed shipment arrives
civic.delivery.body: Shopkeepers spent a night without supplies. The cooperative now delivers three Revival Balms; official services remain open.
civic.contract.polluted.title: Polluted reservoir
civic.contract.polluted.body: Several Belutara died after factory runoff. Their habitat is gone. Technicians can install a filter; you keep the dynamo.
civic.coast.damaged.title: A quiet bay
civic.coast.damaged.body: The new harbour helps fishers but blocks spawning grounds. Fund habitat restoration so Rajapari can return.
civic.news.title: Community News
civic.news.empty: No matters await you. Decisions at the coast, Balai Beton and the workshop will return here.
civic.contract.name: The Workshop Contract
civic.contract.body: The factory offers jobs and a dynamo, but its waste outlet is not ready. Delaying the contract protects the reservoir, while the workshop loses this month’s orders.
civic.contract.option.0.name: Accept the contract
civic.contract.option.0.detail: Industrial Dynamo: Electric moves +20%. Pollution removes Belutara from the reservoir; later restoration costs Rp75.000.
civic.contract.option.1.name: Wait for safety measures
civic.contract.option.1.detail: Receive a Guard Vest. The habitat survives; you forgo the Industrial Dynamo.
civic.coast.name: Whose Harbour?
civic.coast.body: Investors fund a harbour to protect fishers’ catches. Its access road crosses Rajapari’s spawning grounds. The cooperative can build a smaller route that preserves them, but needs contributions.
civic.coast.option.0.name: Express harbour
civic.coast.option.0.detail: Receive Rp120.000. Coastal wildlife becomes scarcer; Rajapari waits until you fund Rp60.000 of restoration.
civic.coast.option.1.name: Cooperative route
civic.coast.option.1.detail: Pay Rp20.000. The habitat stays intact; Rajapari can be met after earning the badge.
civic.permit.name: Official Fee, Back Door
civic.permit.body: “Official kiosk permit: Rp15.000. Need it today? Rp50.000 under the table, no receipt.” Shopkeepers await medicine. Paying speeds delivery, but the broker will demand more. Reporting delays the shipment.
civic.permit.option.0.name: Pay the bribe
civic.permit.option.0.detail: Rp50.000: receive 3 Revival Balms now. At Wargamall, the broker demands another Rp40.000.
civic.permit.option.1.name: Use official channels & report
civic.permit.option.1.detail: Rp15.000: receive 3 Antidotes. The cooperative gives you 3 Revival Balms at Wargamall when the delayed shipment arrives.
league.name: Nusantara League
league.rules: Four Elite members, then the Champion. One team for five battles. No automatic healing. Supplies are allowed; clinics and daycare are closed during the run.
league.restartRule: Leaving the region, losing, or giving up restarts from the first Elite.
league.startHint: Start when your team and supplies are ready. Victory opens the Hall of Champions and Tarsion’s quest.
league.ended: Your League run has ended. Register again to restart.
tarsion.done.title: The courtyard is quiet again
tarsion.done.body: Tarsion is already your companion. This story is complete; there is no second catch.
tarsion.waiting.title: Tarsion awaits
tarsion.waiting.body: “The field is too strong,” says the researcher. “Become Champion and return. One calibration should be enough to free it.”
tarsion.open.body: The containment field is down. Tarsion approaches. Prepare your capsules; it will remain here if you lose, flee, or knock it out.
resonance.opened: The containment field is off. Tarsion awaits in the courtyard.
resonance.notes.rest: The Moon faces opposite the Sun. The Star is one clockwise step from the Moon.
resonance.openStatus: The field is open. Tarsion awaits in the courtyard.
resonance.hint: All three panels are connected. Match the directions, then synchronise.
resonance.unsealed.title: Containment field disabled
resonance.unsealed.body: Tarsion's rings spin again. The researcher gives you three Ultra Capsules. Approach Tarsion in the northern courtyard.
resonance.wrong: Signals are not aligned. Check opposite directions and clockwise order.
hall.wins: {n} League wins. Rematches gain 5 levels per title, up to Lv.80.
hall.empty: Defeat the Elite Four and Champion to record your first team.
map.title: World Map
journal.heading: JOURNEY JOURNAL, {count}
shop.closedLeague: The shop is closed during the League run.
dex.galomang.alt: Galomang, an orange hermit crab carrying a clear blue water jug
dex.galomang.note: AI-generated 3D-style illustration; not a Blender model.
dex.habitat.chapter5: Not found yet. Its home lies across the sea, in Chapter 5 (Seberang).
dex.habitat.event.nyepi: Appears only during the Nyepi event, as the boss of the Pengerupukan parade.
dex.habitat.event.imlek: Appears only during the Chinese New Year event.
dex.habitat.event.jakarta: Appears only during the Jakarta anniversary event.
saves.writeFailed: Slot not saved. Browser storage is full or unavailable.
saves.new.title: New journey?
saves.new.body: Your current journey will be saved to an empty slot. If all slots are full, choose one to overwrite.
connector.closed.title: Connector not open yet
hint.room: Tap a marker, WASD / arrows to move
hint.region: Follow the trail, the camera follows you
route.blocked: The route is blocked. Follow the visible path.
route.noTarget: That destination is not available on this map.
route.noPath: No open route there yet. Check the next objective.
route.followRoad: Follow the road. Routes between regions open when objectives are complete.
route.closed: The route is not open yet. Use Go to objective for guidance.
save.unavailable: Saving is unavailable in this browser
save.blocked: Autosave is off so the old save is not overwritten
save.quarantine.kept: Your previous autosave could not be read, so a new journey begins. It has not been deleted: a copy is kept in this browser and can still be recovered.
save.quarantine.blocked: Your previous autosave could not be read, and this browser has no room to copy it. So that it is not overwritten, autosave is off for this session. Free some browser storage and reload the page.
saves.damaged.note: Some slots cannot be read. Nothing in them is deleted; if you save over one, a copy is kept in this browser first.
starter.title: First companion, long journey.
starter.intro: Bu Sari: “Choose a companion, collect supplies at the stall, then start with the neighbours’ challenges! Explore Padang Ojek, Gang Senggol and Hutan Pinggir Kota. Once the village tasks are complete, Pasar Rakyat opens the way to Arena Beton at Balai Beton.”
loading.paintFailed: The map could not be drawn. Try reloading it.
loading.portraitFailed: Image failed to load. Tap to try again.
loading.portraitFailedLabel: {name}, image failed to load, tap to try again
waduk.gears.title: Service Gears
waduk.gears.hint: Small gear: 2 turns. The medium gear needs twice that; the large gear needs half. Turning the small gear also turns the medium; turning the medium also turns the large.
waduk.irrigation.title: Garden Irrigation
waduk.irrigation.hint: Seven units of water are available. The lotus needs twice as much as the grass; the grass needs twice as much as the flowers.
waduk.waterLimit: Only 7 units of water are available. Reduce another channel first.
waduk.notYet: Not quite. Match the amounts and ratios in the instructions.
team.closeDialogFirst: Close the conversation before opening your team.
waduk.done: Settings correct! The arena is ready.
waduk.prompt: Tap a button to change the setting.
waduk.irrigation.locked: Meet {name} to open the water flow.
waduk.irrigation.help: Connect water from the left of the middle row to its right. Rotate pipes; do not send water into an open edge.
waduk.irrigation.flowing: Water is flowing. The garden is thriving again.
rail.start: Rotate the track tiles. Connect the left entrance to Platform 2 through the upper route.
rail.title: Rail Switchboard
rail.help: Enter from the left of row 2 → exit on its right.
rail.notYet: The rails do not connect yet. Match both ends of every tile, including the top track.
delivery.order.0.name: Coffee counter
delivery.order.1.name: Tempeh counter
delivery.order.2.name: Satay counter
dispatch.title: Delivery Kitchen, {n}/3
dispatch.rules: Deliver within 100 steps. Walk or tap the stall; Go to objective also helps. Cold orders can be collected again for free.
dispatch.ready: Order ready. Follow the objective to the stall.
dispatch.needOrder: Collect an order from the delivery kitchen first.
dispatch.cold: The order has gone cold. Collect a free replacement at the kitchen.
dispatch.wrongStall: Wrong stall. Check your delivery destination.
dispatch.next: Return to the kitchen for the next order.
gang.toast.paid: The directions are recorded; the public signboard is still not up.
gang.toast.community: The signboard is up; residents give you two Jamu and two capsules.
agustus.chat.0: Merdeka! The 17 August lomba (contests) are on at the futsal pitch. There’s a trophy up for grabs!
agustus.chat.1: My red-and-white flag has been up since the first. If yours isn’t, come on, don’t be shy!
agustus.chat.2: Last year I won the kerupuk-eating race. The secret? Hands behind your back, mouth never stops.
agustus.chat.3: The panjat pinang (greasy pole) is so slippery this year. Too much oil, and the bicycle prize is still up top!
debug.editor.narrow: Orange: {n} painted cells are too narrow for the hero, so they stay blocked. A path needs to be 3 cells wide.
debug.editor.confirmCut: This floor cuts off: {places}. Click Save permanently again to save anyway.
find.title: Hidden find
find.found: Tucked into a corner few people pass, you find {item} ×{n}.
find.more: Something else still seems to be hidden in this area.
find.allHere: You have found every hidden find in this area.
find.needs.Air: Something glints in the water, too far to reach. A Water-type Wargamon might fetch it.
find.needs.Batu: Something is wedged behind a big rock. It is too heavy to move alone; a Rock-type Wargamon might manage.
find.needs.Daun: Something is caught behind a thorny thicket. A Leaf-type Wargamon might part the leaves.
find.needs.Listrik: A toolbox sits here with a dead electric lock. An Electric-type Wargamon might bring it back to life.
find.helped.Air: {name} dives in briefly and brings back what was caught in the water: {item} ×{n}.
find.helped.Batu: {name} shifts the big rock. Behind it lies {item} ×{n}.
find.helped.Daun: {name} parts the thick bushes and finds {item} ×{n}.
find.helped.Listrik: {name} jolts the dead lock until the box springs open: {item} ×{n}.

journal.rareGuest.locked: Locals say today's guest Wargamon is visiting an area you have not opened yet.
field.tide.note: High tide at Arena Pasang: throughout the match, every Wargamon on the field stays Soaked.
field.tide.log: The tide floods the arena; every Wargamon is Soaked.
field.surge.note: The workshop contract went ahead, so factory current runs into the arena: Electric and Metal moves hit harder for both sides.
field.surge.log: The factory machines roar; the arena's current is running strong.
field.blackout.note: The workshop contract was put on hold, so the arena is in a rolling blackout: Electric moves are weaker for both sides.
field.blackout.log: The arena lights go out; Electric moves lose their power.
ambush.31: Hold it right there! Only climbers with a tested team get to pass this trail. I've been watching you, so prove it now!
wild.variant.batik: A wild {name} appeared, wearing {batik} batik colours! ✦
batik.note: Rare colours: one wild Wargamon in 128. Its batik pattern stays for life.
tower.noItems: The bag stays shut in the Battle Tower. Use moves and switches only.
tower.name: Battle Tower
tower.locked: The Battle Tower is open to Nusantara League Champions only. Beat the Elite Four and the Champion first.
tower.intro: Climb floor after floor against random teams of Wargamon no other trainer uses. How many floors can your team take?
tower.rules.title: Tower rules
tower.rules.pool: Opponents use Wargamon no trainer fields, shuffled every floor. Teams start at 3 and grow by one every 10 floors, up to 6.
tower.rules.levels: Floor 1 starts at Lv.{n} and rises one level per floor up to Lv.80. Higher up, opponents bring a plan, gear and Jamu.
tower.rules.noItems: The bag is shut during battles: no medicine, no capsules. Held gear still works.
tower.rules.rest: No healing between floors. Every {n} floors there is a short rest: those still standing recover {pct}% HP and lose conditions.
tower.rules.sameTeam: The same team must climb from start to finish. Clinics outside don't help: HP and conditions carry over from the last floor.
tower.rules.end: A run ends when your whole team faints or you stop. Your best floor count is always kept.
tower.rules.rewards: Each floor gives 1 Tower Point, +1 on every 5th floor and +2 more on every 10th. Trophies at floors 10, 25 and 50 add bonus points.
tower.mismatch: Your team is not the one that started this run. Bring back the same team, or end the run.
tower.quitDone: Run over after {n} floors. Points and record are kept.
tower.lost.title: Run over
tower.lost.body: Your team fell on floor {floor}. Floors cleared: {n}.
tower.rested: Short rest: teammates still standing recover {pct}% HP.
teamCode.title: Team Codes
teamCode.intro: Share your team code with friends. A friend's code can be battled as a ghost team, and you may receive one Wargamon from it in trade.
teamCode.copyManual: The code is selected: copy it with Ctrl+C, or long-press and copy.
teamCode.noTeam: Bring at least one Wargamon to make a code.
teamCode.rules: Trades: each code once, at most {n} a day, no legends, and no higher level than your strongest Wargamon. Held gear stays with the sender.
teamCode.error.format: That is not a Wargamon team code. Codes start with WG1.
teamCode.error.version: This code is from a version this game doesn't know.
teamCode.error.checksum: The code is damaged or mistyped. Copy the whole code again.
teamCode.error.invalid: This code's contents are not valid.
teamCode.error.level: This code holds an impossible level.
teamCode.reviewBody: Battle this team as a ghost team any time, or receive one Wargamon from it.
teamCode.tradeNote: Ghost teams fight with their gear. Winning pays no money, only XP.
teamCode.block.used: You already traded with this code.
teamCode.block.level: Its level is above your strongest Wargamon.
teamCode.receivedTeam: The new Wargamon joins your team. Its held gear stays with the sender.
teamCode.receivedStorage: Your team is full, so the new Wargamon waits at the daycare.
teamCode.ghostWonBody: Send your team code back so your friend can answer.
teamCode.ghostLostBody: Your team fainted. Recover, then try again any time.

seberang.peg.done: All three ironwood pegs collected! Fit them into the pinisi hull at the shipyard.
seberang.hull.title: Pinisi hull
seberang.hull.need: The hull still has gaps. The master shipwright needs three ironwood pegs; you have brought {n}.
seberang.hull.after: The new pinisi is already afloat in the bay. Children are racing to climb aboard.
seberang.hull.launch.title: Annyorong lopi! (Push the boat!)
seberang.hull.launch.body: The three pegs are in. The whole village pushes the hull together, "Annyorong lopi!", and the pinisi slides into the sea. Nobody pays Barisan Bara's mooring fee today.
seberang.hull.launch.next: {name} is waiting at the shipyard with the Pinisi Stamp.
seberang.mark.done.title: The ironwood trees are safe
seberang.mark.done.body: All three saw marks are gone. No old ironwood will fall tonight. {name} wants to see you at the ranger post.
seberang.carving.title: Pa'ssura' carvings
seberang.carving.clue: The elder's saying: "The buffalo faces north, where the ancestors came from. The rooster greets the sun from the east. The sun goes down to the south, to the rice fields." Turn each carving, then check.
seberang.carving.done: All three carvings face the ancestors' directions again.
seberang.carving.hint: Each press turns a carving a quarter turn.
seberang.carving.wrong: That does not match the elder's saying yet. Read it again slowly.
seberang.carving.status.done: The carvings are restored. {name} is ready for your challenge.
seberang.carving.blocked: This courtyard has been staked out! Want to touch the carvings? Get past me first.
seberang.machine.title: Ember Engine {n}
seberang.machine.guarded: This engine belongs to Barisan Bara. Don't you dare touch the lever!
seberang.machine.off: You pull the lever and the engine stops humming. Engines off: {n}/3.
seberang.machine.allOff: All three Ember Engines are off. The crater breathes easy and the temples stop shaking. Meet {name} in the temple yard.
seberang.komodo.title: Small island
seberang.komodo.locked: There are big footprints in the sand of the islet, but without a boat you cannot get there. Perhaps once the new pinisi is launched.
seberang.komodo.body: A fisher ferries you across in a canoe. Komodobrak, the giant lizard from Nusa Tenggara, is sunbathing on the coral rocks. It will battle once a day.
seberang.komodo.tomorrow: Komodobrak is taking its afternoon nap. Come back tomorrow.
seberang.elangkasa.locked: The sky above the crater is choked with Ember Engine smoke. Its guardian returns only when Barisan Bara has left Dieng.
seberang.elangkasa.owned: Elangkasa already flies with you. The crater wind is clean now.
seberang.elangkasa.body: The smoke is gone and the guardian eagle of the sky is back on the crater rim. It waits for anyone brave enough to approach. If you fail, you may try again.
seberang.cap.title: {cap}!
seberang.cap.supplies: Your team is restored. Supplies: 3 Ultra Capsules and 2 Strong Jamu.
seberang.cap.next.15: The harbour road climbs north into Rimba Ulin. Careful: Barisan Bara reached the forest first.
seberang.cap.next.16: The ranger trail continues east to Lembah Tongkonan, where Barisan Bara is handing out fake certificates.
seberang.cap.next.17: Barisan Bara's bailiff is still waiting at the lookout. After that, the stone road goes down to Kawah Dieng.
seberang.cap.next.18: The Mandor Besi is waiting on the crater rim. This is Barisan Bara's last stand across the sea.
seberang.admin.title: The seizure papers come apart
seberang.admin.body: Bu Segel's folder holds an order with an ember stamp: "Empty the valley, pipe Dieng's steam to Kota Sagara. Signed: Mandor Besi." The tongkonan deeds go back to the valley families.
seberang.boss.title: Barisan Bara retreats from Seberang
seberang.boss.body: The Mandor Besi takes the last boat to Kota Sagara. The people of Dieng take the steam pipes apart. But every order he carried came from the New Order Party (Partai Tatanan Baru) in Kota Sagara, where Barisan Bara still collects its "security contributions". Reward: Rp150,000 and 5 Ultra Capsules.
seberang.boss.elangkasa: The smoke thins. From the crater rim comes the cry of an eagle long gone.
seberang.ending.title: The boat to Kota Sagara
seberang.ending.body: Elangkasa circles over Dieng. From Teluk Pinisi to Lembah Tongkonan, people pull down Barisan Bara's stakes and signs. Pak Darto is waiting for you at the pier.
seberang.ending.darto: Barisan Bara has gone home to Kota Sagara, the city where I used to keep the night watch. There is Serikat Lentera there, young people who stand up to them without fear. My boat sails there every week. Your story here is done, Champion. Theirs is only beginning.
seberang.ending.tactics: Kota Sagara is the setting of Warga Tactics. Your progress here can be read there: your Wargamon partner can help Serikat Lentera.
seberang.darto.role: PINISI SKIPPER, ONCE A NIGHT WATCHMAN IN KOTA SAGARA
seberang.darto.arrive: Welcome across the sea, Champion! I used to keep a night-watch post in Kota Sagara, before I moved and ran the travel cards at Pasar Rakyat. That ember stamp on the broker's receipt? I know it. Barisan Bara. They collect their dues here too. Help the master shipwright launch the pinisi first.
seberang.darto.middle: Rimba Ulin and Lembah Tongkonan both need help. Barisan Bara always starts with paper: marks, stakes, certificates. Beat the paper and the people will stand on their own.
seberang.darto.dieng: Their bailiff has fled to Dieng. The Mandor Besi is there with his engines. Be careful, son.
seberang.darto.elang: The Mandor Besi has run off to Kota Sagara! I hear the great eagle is back on the crater rim. Don't miss it.
seberang.darto.after: My boat sails to Kota Sagara every week. If you hear news of Serikat Lentera, tell me, won't you?
seberang.objective.sail.title: Cross the sea with Pak Darto
seberang.objective.sail.detail: The connector on Liga Nusantara's north trail takes you to Teluk Pinisi.
seberang.objective.elangkasa.title: Meet Elangkasa on the crater rim
seberang.objective.elangkasa.detail: The Wind legend returns once Barisan Bara has gone. Bring capsules.
journal.bara.harbour: Barisan Bara collects mooring fees at Teluk Pinisi.
journal.bara.valley: Barisan Bara is marking the forest and staking out the valley.
journal.bara.crater: The Mandor Besi holds out at Kawah Dieng with the Ember Engines.
journal.bara.gone: Barisan Bara has left Seberang and gone back to Kota Sagara.
bara.clues.title: Traces of Barisan Bara
bara.clue.permit: The permit broker's receipts at Balai Beton all carry the same stamp: a small red ember.
bara.clue.contract: The factory behind the workshop contract is registered as "PT Bara Sagara".
bara.clue.coast: The express pier's investor arrived on a ship from Kota Sagara.
bara.clue.tagih: The "security contribution" collector at Balai Beton says a boss in Kota Sagara sent him.
bara.clue.asap: The workshop factory's overseer wears a red ember pin, the badge of Barisan Bara.
bara.clues.more: It is not clear yet who they are. Keep an eye out for that red ember stamp.
bara.clues.sail: Pak Darto says the trail leads across the sea. Find him on Liga Nusantara's north trail.
gate.leader.59.trainer: The pinisi is not ready and the pier is not safe yet. Get past {names} first.
gate.leader.59.task: My pinisi hull is still waiting for three ironwood pegs. Fit them first, then we battle.
gate.leader.64.trainer: The forest is not at peace yet. Deal with {names} first.
gate.leader.64.task: There are still trees with red marks. Remove all three first.
gate.leader.68.trainer: The courtyard is still staked out. Face {names} first.
gate.leader.68.task: The pa'ssura' carvings do not face their directions yet. Restore them first, child.
gate.leader.69.trainer: Your business with the elder is not done. Beat {names} first, then I will talk.
gate.leader.70.trainer: The ruwatan child wants to test you first. Battle {names}.
gate.leader.70.task: While the Ember Engines roar, our play cannot begin. Switch all three off.
gate.leader.74.trainer: Hah! Beat {names} first. I do not waste my time on children.
universe.news.title: News from Kota Sagara
universe.news.none: No news from Serikat Lentera yet. If you play Warga Tactics on the same site, the news will reach you here.
universe.news.firstWin: Serikat Lentera won its first fight at Bu Ratih's warteg! A Barisan Bara thug has turned over a new leaf and sailed to Teluk Pinisi.
universe.news.finale: Serikat Lentera has freed Kota Sagara. They sent 3 Ultra Capsules as thanks.
universe.unlock.firstWin: News from Kota Sagara: a former Barisan Bara member is waiting at Teluk Pinisi.
universe.unlock.finale: News from Kota Sagara: Serikat Lentera has won! +3 Ultra Capsules.
universe.defector.gift.title: A parcel from Kota Sagara
universe.defector.gift.body: This Komodobrak was raised in the workshop of Raka, Serikat Lentera's mechanic. It joins you.
resident.234.name: Wa Bacce, pisang epe seller
resident.234.0: Pisang epe: banana pressed flat, grilled and drenched in palm sugar. Try one and you'll be hooked.
resident.234.1: A pinisi is built without blueprints. It is all in the master shipwright's head. Amazing, right?
resident.234.2: Those Barisan Bara people want mooring fees even from little canoes. How heartless.
resident.235.name: Pak Tamen, Dayak guide
resident.235.0: Ironwood gets harder the longer it sits in water. Our longhouses stand for hundreds of years.
resident.235.1: The hornbill is a sacred bird to us. If it leaves, the forest is sick.
resident.235.2: Young orangutans love stealing hikers' hats. Hold on to yours.
resident.236.name: Indo' Lai, Sa'dan weaver
resident.236.0: This woven cloth has the same motifs as the tongkonan carvings. Its story is woven, not written.
resident.236.1: The tongkonan roofs curve like boats. Our ancestors came from the sea, they say.
resident.236.2: The children pull out those fake stakes every morning. Barisan Bara puts them back every night.
resident.237.name: Mbok Sumi, Dieng potato seller
resident.237.0: Dieng potatoes are best eaten warm, especially on a misty morning like this.
resident.237.1: Children with dreadlocks here have a ruwatan ceremony when they are ready. Their wish must be granted, you know.
resident.237.2: Since those engines came, the crater smells sharper and the temples shake every night.
trainer.53.name: Bang Tagor Iuran
trainer.53.line: Security contribution, kid. Safe stalls, safe streets, a wallet that is... well, a bit lighter.
trainer.53.win: Oh dear. The boss in Kota Sagara won't be happy. Let's pretend I was never here.
trainer.54.name: Juragan Asap Tebal
trainer.54.line: The contract is signed, the chimney is lit. Filters? Later, when there is time.
trainer.54.win: Hmph. Put my name in your newspaper, then. Barisan Bara has plenty of other chimneys.
trainer.55.name: Daeng Tali Temali
trainer.55.line: Seven sails, two masts, and one wrong knot sends the ship round in circles. Come on, test your knots!
trainer.55.win: Strong knots. No wonder Pak Darto dared to bring you across.
trainer.56.name: Andi Tuna Sirip
trainer.56.line: Fresh fish this morning, fresh battle this afternoon. The loser buys es pisang ijo!
trainer.56.win: Ouch, I lost. Two es pisang ijo, then? One for you, one for your partner.
trainer.57.name: Romo Iramalaut
trainer.57.line: Staying up late is fine, as long as it means something. Battling is fine, as long as it has rhythm!
trainer.57.win: Terlalu! (Too much!) Your rhythm is tidier than my kendang drum.
trainer.58.name: Bang Pungli Labuh
trainer.58.line: Want to use the pier? Pay the mooring fee first. A receipt? Ahem, the ember stamp will do.
trainer.58.win: All right, all right! The pier is free today. Don't tell the Mandor Besi.
trainer.59.name: Puang Lopi Sumanga
trainer.59.line: A pinisi is not built from drawings, child, but from memory. Show me that your team has a memory too.
trainer.59.win: Your pegs are strong, your sails stand tall. Take the Pinisi Stamp. Ewako! (Fight on!)
trainer.60.name: Birute Galdikasih
trainer.60.line: An orangutan learns from its mother for eight years. How long have you learned from your team?
trainer.60.win: Patient and careful. You would make a good forest volunteer.
trainer.61.name: Didi Kemahrimba
trainer.61.line: My heart goes ambyar (to pieces) seeing the forest marked with red paint. Let us battle, so my heart feels a little lighter.
trainer.61.win: Even when I lose, I still dance. Keep this forest green, all right?
trainer.62.name: Bang Gergaji Liar
trainer.62.line: Those red-marked trees have been bought by the boss. Out of the way, village kid!
trainer.62.win: My saw is blunt and so is my team. I'm going back to the boat.
trainer.63.name: Mbah Asap Pekat
trainer.63.line: Hee hee. My smoke makes the forest rangers sneeze all night. Want a try?
trainer.63.win: Cough! My smoke went into my own eyes. Enough, enough.
trainer.64.name: Kak Tingang Lestari
trainer.64.line: The hornbill flies high because its forest is whole. Prove that you help to guard it.
trainer.64.win: This forest has a new guardian. Take the Ironwood Stamp.
trainer.65.name: Marthen Kopitoraja
trainer.65.line: The coffee of this valley is honestly bitter. Is your play honest too?
trainer.65.win: Honest and strong. Drop by my stall, the coffee is free.
trainer.66.name: Iwan Falsawah
trainer.66.line: My guitar has only three strings left, but my spirit is whole. Let us battle on the paddy dyke!
trainer.66.win: You beat me the way rain waters a rice field: slowly, but surely.
trainer.67.name: Bang Patok Palsu
trainer.67.line: This stake is official! Look at the stamp: a red ember. It is official, full stop!
trainer.67.win: Yes, yes, I'll pull the stakes out. The stamp is only a rubber one anyway.
trainer.68.name: Ne' Tominaa Sanda
trainer.68.line: The tongkonan face north, where the ancestors came from. Face me with a straight heart.
trainer.68.win: The carvings are restored and your heart is straight. Take the Tongkonan Stamp.
trainer.69.name: Bu Segel Sumbara
trainer.69.line: The deeds to this valley have been sealed in the name of progress. Sign here, or step aside.
trainer.69.win: All my files seized... by me? Report to the Mandor Besi at Dieng!
trainer.70.name: Sujiwo Tejokawah
trainer.70.line: The wayang has its story, the crater has its breath. Let us play out our own story.
trainer.70.win: A fine performance; even the audience is on its feet. Take the Dieng Stamp.
trainer.71.name: Dik Gimbal Ruwatan
trainer.71.line: My hair is in dreadlocks and I only have one wish: to win just once!
trainer.71.win: My wish has changed: I want to be strong like you.
trainer.72.name: Bang Pipa Bocor
trainer.72.line: This pipe carries crater steam to Kota Sagara. A little leak? Normal!
trainer.72.win: The leak is getting worse. Just switch the engine off, I'm not involved.
trainer.73.name: Mbak Bidik Uap
trainer.73.line: My aim never misses. Except in fog. Dieng is always foggy...
trainer.73.win: It's the fog's fault! Definitely the fog!
trainer.74.name: Mandor Besi Gardabara
trainer.74.line: Not permission, kid. Protection. New rates, new orders from Kota Sagara.
trainer.74.win: You only bought one quiet afternoon. The New Order Party still holds Kota Sagara.
trainer.75.name: Bang Tobat Arangdingin
trainer.75.role: Former Barisan Bara member from Kota Sagara
trainer.75.line: Serikat Lentera in Kota Sagara brought me to my senses. Now I want to know: are you as strong as their stories?
trainer.75.win: That ember has gone cold. Take this parcel from a Kota Sagara workshop, will you?

region.15.questText: Collect three ironwood pegs at the shipyard, the fish market and the end of the harbour road, then fit them into the pinisi hull. Get past {trainer55}, see off {trainer58}, then challenge {trainer59}.
region.15.story:
Pak Darto's pinisi anchors in the bay of the boat builders. The master shipwright is preparing a launch, but Barisan Bara is taking a "mooring fee" from every boat.

From the pier, the road climbs to Rimba Ulin. The big ships in this bay sail on to Kota Sagara.
region.16.questText: {trainer62} and {trainer63} have marked three ironwood trees with red paint. Remove all three marks, help {trainer60}, then meet {trainer64} at the ranger post.
region.16.story: The old ironwood forest is home to hornbills and orangutans. Barisan Bara's red paint marks have appeared on the oldest trunks: the marked trees will be felled tonight.
region.16.goal: Three red marks → {trainer62} and {trainer63} → {trainer64} → Ironwood Stamp.
region.17.questText: {trainer67}'s fake stakes close the courtyard. Turn the three tongkonan carvings as the elder's saying tells, battle {trainer68}, then face {trainer69} at the lookout.
region.17.story: In the Toraja valley the tongkonan stand in a row facing north. Barisan Bara has arrived with ember-stamped certificates and new boundary stakes. Ne' Tominaa needs help restoring the carvings they took down.
region.18.questText: Beat the engine guards, {trainer72} and {trainer73}, switch off the three Ember Engines, ask {trainer70} for a blessing, then face {trainer74} on the crater rim.
region.18.story: The Dieng plateau is wrapped in sulphur mist. The Ember Engines pump crater steam into pipes bound for Kota Sagara. Since then the temples shake and the great eagle that guards the sky has vanished.

seberang.crossing.title: Crossing by pinisi
seberang.crossing.body: The seven sails of Pak Darto's pinisi fill with wind. After a night at sea, Liga Nusantara is gone behind you and the bay of the boat builders rises ahead. "I used to keep the night watch in Kota Sagara," says Pak Darto. "That red ember stamp on the broker's receipts belongs to Barisan Bara. They have reached this side of the sea too."
cal.imlek.title: Gong Xi Fa Cai! Imlek in the kampung
cal.imlek.body: Red lanterns hang from shop to shop, and the barongsai (lion dance) is ready to perform outside Pasar Rakyat. Koh Ahong says whoever keeps the best beat on the drum gets to see Barongcuan dance up close.
cal.imlek.today: Imlek (Chinese New Year): the barongsai and Barongcuan at Pasar Rakyat and Wargamall.
cal.imlek.soon: Imlek, Chinese New Year ({date}): lion dance and angpao, {when}.
cal.imlek.angpao: Koh Ahong gives you a red angpao (lucky envelope): {money}. A lucky number!
cal.imlek.appears: Your drumming calls {name}! It leaps down from the poles and wants to play.
cal.imlek.follow: {name} loved your drumming and follows you off the stage!
cal.imlek.chat.0: Gong xi fa cai! Got your angpao yet? I got three, and two of them were sweets.
cal.imlek.chat.1: This year the barongsai leaps so high between the poles. My heart leapt with it!
cal.imlek.chat.2: The neighbours brought kue keranjang (sticky New Year cake). Sweet and sticky, just like missing someone.
cal.pengerupukan.title: Pengerupukan night: the ogoh-ogoh parade
cal.pengerupukan.body: Tomorrow is Nyepi. Tonight the banjar (neighbourhood) parades the ogoh-ogoh, giant effigies of the bhuta kala demons, with torches and baleganjur gamelan. They say the biggest one, Ogohgoro, comes alive and challenges anyone still out.
cal.pengerupukan.today: Pengerupukan, the eve of Nyepi: the ogoh-ogoh parade and the boss Ogohgoro.
cal.pengerupukan.soon: Ogoh-ogoh parade on the eve of Nyepi, {when}.
cal.pengerupukan.go: Join the parade and face Ogohgoro
cal.pengerupukan.done: Ogohgoro has been burned at the setra (cremation ground). Tomorrow is silent, so get some rest.
cal.pengerupukan.log: The baleganjur speeds up... Ogohgoro comes alive and blocks the parade! A boss cannot be caught.
cal.pengerupukan.win: The crowd cheers and the ogoh-ogoh is burned at the setra: the evil spirits leave before Nyepi. Parade prize: {money}, 3 Ultra Capsules and a canang offering that steadies your capsule throws.
cal.pengerupukan.chat.0: Our banjar’s ogoh-ogoh is as tall as a power pole this year. Let’s hope it doesn’t snag the cables!
cal.pengerupukan.chat.1: Tonight is loud, tomorrow totally silent. Stock up on food first, okay?
cal.pengerupukan.chat.2: Hear the baleganjur? Dung-dung-cring! It gives me goosebumps.
cal.nyepi.title: Nyepi: the day of silence
cal.nyepi.body: Catur Brata Penyepian: no fire or lights, no work, no travel, no entertainment. Until 06:00 tomorrow there is no music, wild Wargamon stay quiet too, the lights are off and shops and stalls are closed. Clinics stay open.
cal.nyepi.today: Nyepi, silent until 06:00: no music, no wild Wargamon, shops closed.
cal.nyepi.closed: Closed for Nyepi. Open again at 06:00 tomorrow.
cal.nyepi.noWild: Nyepi: every wild Wargamon is keeping the silence today.
cal.nyepi.chat.0: (whispering) Shh. It’s Nyepi today. Let’s keep our voices down.
cal.nyepi.chat.1: (whispering) The night sky with no lights is so beautiful. You can see every star.
cal.nyepi.chat.2: (whispering) I’m doing mulat sarira, quiet reflection. Or napping. It’s a fine line.
cal.ramadan.title: Marhaban ya Ramadan (welcome, Ramadan)
cal.ramadan.body: The fasting month is here. In the afternoon people ngabuburit (pass the time until sunset) waiting for the maghrib call, and takjil stalls (snacks for breaking the fast) line up at the warungs. At night Pak Hansip goes round with the kentongan (bamboo drum) to wake everyone for sahur (the pre-dawn meal).
cal.ramadan.today: Ramadan: Pasar Takjil (fast-breaking snacks) at warungs and food stalls, 17:30–19:00.
cal.ramadan.hours: Pasar Takjil opens before maghrib, 17:30–19:00, at Bu Sari’s warung and the food stalls.
cal.ramadan.ronda: It’s the fasting month: after the watch we go round with the kentongan to wake everyone for sahur. Sa-hur, sa-hur!
cal.ramadan.sahur: Then the kentongan rings round the alleys: “Sahur, sahur!” Pak Hansip shares his sahur rice, and the team’s Fullness is full.
cal.ramadan.chat.0: Just doing ngabuburit, a stroll until the maghrib call so the fast flies by.
cal.ramadan.chat.1: They say the banana kolak at Pasar Takjil is great this evening. The queue’s been snaking since five.
cal.ramadan.chat.2: Last night the sahur kentongan came by at three. I woke up, ate, went back to sleep. Efficient.
cal.takjil.title: Pasar Takjil (fast-breaking snacks)
cal.takjil.body: The maghrib call is close. One of each snack for today:
cal.takjil.kolak.name: Banana kolak
cal.takjil.kolak.done: Warm banana kolak: the team recovers a little and feels full.
cal.takjil.esbuah.name: Es buah (iced fruit)
cal.takjil.esbuah.done: Fresh es buah! The team’s eyes are sharp for 3 battles.
cal.takjil.gorengan.name: Gorengan (fritters)
cal.takjil.gorengan.done: The bakwan and stuffed tofu are still hot: the team hits harder for 3 battles.
cal.takjil.kurma.name: Dates
cal.takjil.kurma.desc: Break the fast with something sweet: sturdier for 3 battles
cal.takjil.kurma.done: Breaking the fast with something sweet: the team is sturdier for 3 battles.
cal.lebaran.title: Selamat Hari Raya Idulfitri! (Happy Eid)
cal.lebaran.body: The takbir has echoed since last night. This morning everyone prayed Eid prayers, then went house to house shaking hands: “Mohon maaf lahir dan batin” (forgive me, body and soul). Pak RT is handing out THR (holiday money) to every kampung kid, you included.
cal.lebaran.today: Lebaran (Eid): THR from Pak RT, ketupat and opor, and “maaf lahir batin” from everyone.
cal.lebaran.soon: Lebaran, Eid al-Fitr ({date}): THR and ketupat, {when}.
cal.lebaran.thrHome: You were already given your THR at home today, so Pak RT just shakes your hand.
cal.lebaran.ketupat: Ketupat (rice cakes) and opor (chicken in coconut milk) heal and fill the team, and make it sturdier for 3 battles.
cal.lebaran.chat.0: Mohon maaf lahir dan batin! If I ever said something wrong, let it blow away with the wind.
cal.lebaran.chat.1: Minal aidin wal faizin! Drop by, there are still plenty of nastar and kastengel (pineapple tarts and cheese biscuits) in the jars.
cal.lebaran.chat.2: Maaf lahir batin! This year I was only asked “when are you getting married” seven times. A record low!
cal.jakarta.title: Dirgahayu Jakarta! The ondel-ondel take to the streets
cal.jakarta.body: The city celebrates its birthday on 22 June. The ondel-ondel (giant Betawi puppets) sway down the street to tanjidor brass, and Ondelgondel dances along in the parks of Pasar Rakyat and Wargamall.
cal.jakarta.today: HUT Jakarta (the city’s birthday): ondel-ondel parades, Ondelgondel in the Pasar Rakyat and Wargamall parks.
cal.jakarta.kerak: The kerak telor (spiced egg crust) seller gives you a plate: the team hits harder for 3 battles.
cal.jakarta.chat.0: The ondel-ondel passed my house earlier. So tall my cat fled to the roof.
cal.jakarta.chat.1: Kerak telor, kerak telor! Duck egg, never chicken. It’s a matter of principle.
cal.jakarta.chat.2: Tanjidor is Betawi music. The trumpets lift your spirits even in a traffic jam.
cal.agustus.title: Merdeka! The Lomba 17-an begins
cal.agustus.body: Red-and-white flags fly in every alley. The RT committee is holding contests on the Sukamaju futsal pitch: the penalty shoot-out, panjat pinang (greasy pole), balap karung (sack race) and makan kerupuk (cracker-eating).
cal.agustus.today: Lomba 17-an (Independence Day contests) on the Sukamaju futsal pitch.
cal.agustus.where: Go to the Sukamaju futsal pitch and pick a contest. The first win of each contest this year earns a Pita Merah Putih (red-and-white ribbon).
dailynews.head: Today’s Kabar Warga
dailynews.effect: Wild {type}-type Wargamon turn up more often today.
dailynews.effect.none: Wild Wargamon turn up as usual today.
dailynews.cerah.headline: Bright and partly cloudy all day.
dailynews.cerah.lead: BMKG (the weather office) says it will be fine. Washing dries, ojeks are busy, everyone is happy.
dailynews.banjir.headline: Floodwater from upstream swamps the kampung roads!
dailynews.banjir.lead: The river burst its banks overnight. Sandals float away, kids sail bucket boats, and water Wargamon swim right into the alleys.
dailynews.matilampu.headline: Rolling power cuts until the afternoon.
dailynews.matilampu.lead: The substation is overloaded. The neighbours’ generators roar, and electric Wargamon crowd the poles looking for a charge.
dailynews.kemarau.headline: A long dry spell and scorching heat.
dailynews.kemarau.lead: Wells run low and the grass turns yellow. Fire Wargamon love basking on the hot asphalt.
dailynews.angin.headline: Strong winds: kites snapping everywhere.
dailynews.angin.lead: Washing flies off the lines, roof tiles rattle, and wind Wargamon dance over the paddies.
dailynews.hujan.headline: Drizzle since dawn: planting season is here.
dailynews.hujan.lead: Farmers head into the paddies, gardens turn green, and leaf Wargamon pop out of the bushes.
dailynews.longsor.headline: A small landslide: the neighbourhood turns out to clear it.
dailynews.longsor.lead: Rocks and earth block the footpath. Everyone pitches in to clear it, and rock Wargamon come tumbling down too.
dailynews.krl.headline: KRL commuter line delays: platforms packed.
dailynews.krl.lead: The commuter trains are held at signals. Passengers spill onto the streets, and crowd-loving Wargamon squeeze in with them.
dailynews.rongsok.headline: Scrap metal prices are up: the scrap yards are busy.
dailynews.rongsok.lead: Scrap carts rattle back and forth from morning, and metal Wargamon roam about looking for loose screws.
dailynews.story.0: The Sukamaju primary school trip is back from Borobudur. One pupil swears a little stupa moved on its own. The teacher says it was tiredness. The pupil says the stupa waved.
dailynews.story.1: A Pesisir fisherman is back from Labuan Bajo with a tale of a komodo as big as a boat. Our reporter asked for a photo. It is blurry; apparently the komodo was too fast.
dailynews.story.2: The Balai Beton arts studio opens a gamelan class for children. Pak Joni reminds everyone: one gong player is plenty.
dailynews.story.3: The level-5 seblak contest at Pasar Rakyat ended with no winner. Every contestant gave up and queued for iced tea.
dailynews.story.4: The reog show at Festival Arus paused briefly: the dadak merak peacock mask snagged a lamp post. The warok says it was part of the act.
dailynews.story.5: The cilok seller outside the primary school now takes QR payments. Same price, same sauce, even longer queue.
dailynews.story.6: The pencak silat school by the forest is taking new pupils. Requirements: be up at dawn and not afraid of mosquitoes.
dailynews.story.7: A travelling dangdut band played at the Festival bus stop. The crowd danced, the angkot drivers danced, even the shelter swayed. The council is inspecting it.
mini.paid: Today’s prize is claimed. Play again for fun, or come back tomorrow.
mini.reward: Win today for the daily prize (capsules and medicine, better as your journey goes on).
rhythm.rules: Press the lane’s key (D F J K, or 1–4) or tap the lane as a note touches the line.
rhythm.pass: Performance {n}%, best combo {combo}. The crowd applauds!
rhythm.fail: Performance {n}%, best combo {combo}. You need 60% for applause. Try again!
rhythm.ready: Get ready... here comes the first note!
rhythm.angklung.title: Play angklung with Kak Lala
rhythm.angklung.rules: Each lane is one angklung (bamboo rattle): do, re, mi, sol. Shake it right on the beat.
rhythm.dangdut.title: Dangdut kendang on the festival stage
rhythm.dangdut.rules: Lanes 1 and 2 are kendang drums, 3 and 4 the suling flute. Tak-dut, tak-dut: don’t let the crowd stop dancing!
rhythm.gamelan.title: Play the bonang before the wayang
rhythm.gamelan.rules: Four bonang kettles in the pelog scale. Slow and stately: the dalang is waiting.
rhythm.barongsai.title: The barongsai drum
rhythm.barongsai.rules: Lanes 1–3 are the drum, lane 4 the cymbals. The lion leaps every time you hit the beat.
kite.title: Fly a kite with Mbak Sinta
kite.rules: Hold Pull (Space) to pull the string: the kite climbs, but the string tightens, faster in a strong gust. Let go to give it line: the string slackens and the kite sinks if the wind is weak. Too tight and it snaps; too low and it falls. Stay up for {n} seconds, and high, to win.
kite.snap: Snap! The string broke. The kite drifts off somewhere, with the kids already chasing it.
kite.fall: The kite dives and snags a tree. Pull more often when the wind is weak.
kite.low: The kite is still flying, but too low. Get it higher before time runs out.
kite.win: Your kite dances high in the sky! {name} sees it and swoops closer: today your next {n} wild encounters in Padang Ojek and Pesisir Suaka are far likelier to be {name}.
kite.tight: The string is very tight! Give it some line. {n} seconds left.
kite.sinking: The kite is sinking, pull! {n} seconds left.
kite.flying: The kite is flying. {n} seconds left.
congklak.title: Congklak with Mbah Sepuh
congklak.rules: Pick one of your holes (bottom row, keys 1–7) and sow its seeds one by one to the right, on into your rumah (store) and along Mbah’s row, but never into Mbah’s rumah. Last seed in your rumah: go again. In a hole with seeds: take them all and keep sowing. In an empty hole of yours: nembak, capture the seeds in the hole opposite. The fuller rumah wins.
congklak.start: Mbah lays out the sapodilla seeds, seven in every hole. “Go ahead, youngsters first.”
congklak.you.home: Your last seed lands in your rumah. Go again!
congklak.you.stop: Your seeds went round for too long. Mbah’s turn.
congklak.you.nembak: Nembak! You capture {n} seeds into your rumah.
congklak.you.empty: Your last seed falls in an empty hole, and the one opposite is empty too. Mbah’s turn.
congklak.you.mati: Your last seed dies in an empty hole on Mbah’s side. Mbah’s turn.
congklak.mbah.home: Mbah smiles: his last seed lands in his rumah. Mbah goes again.
congklak.mbah.stop: Mbah’s seeds went round for too long. Your turn.
congklak.mbah.nembak: Mbah captures {n} seeds from your hole. “Hehe, not watchful enough yet.”
congklak.mbah.empty: Mbah’s last seed falls in an empty hole of his own. Your turn.
congklak.mbah.mati: Mbah’s last seed dies in an empty hole on your side. Your turn.
congklak.win: You win, {you} to {mbah}! “Well, the young ones these days can count.”
congklak.lose: Mbah wins, {mbah} to {you}. “Play again tomorrow, Mbah isn’t going anywhere.”
congklak.draw: A draw, {you} to {mbah}. Mbah laughs until he coughs.
congklak.camp.title: The congklak board
congklak.camp.body: On the post bench, an old man is setting up a wooden congklak board. “Mbah Sepuh,” he says. “Keep an old man company for a game?”
bargain.today: Today the end stall has {good}, opening price {price}. Dare to haggle?
bargain.buah.name: A basket of fresh fruit
bargain.buah.desc: Holds 4 Potions, packed in with papaya and salak.
bargain.batik.name: A stamped batik cloth
bargain.batik.desc: Parang-pattern stamped batik sewn into a scarf: one Spirit Scarf.
bargain.loak.name: Capsules from the junk stall
bargain.loak.desc: 5 used but still sealed Capsules. The seller says: “Used by a League player!”
bargain.jamu.name: Wholesale jamu sachets
bargain.line.open: This is good stuff. Only {price}, that’s already cheap.
bargain.line.deal: All right, deal! My first sale of the day.
bargain.line.insult: Goodness, that doesn’t even cover my costs! Don’t be like that. {price}, my absolute limit.
bargain.line.below: Not yet. Come up a little. I’ll do {price}.
bargain.line.angry: Enough, enough. Try another stall. We’ll try again tomorrow.
bargain.line.final: Fixed price now: {price}. Take it or leave it?
bargain.line.called: Hey, hey, wait! Don’t go yet. {price}, then. Just for you.
bargain.line.gone: Fine, off you go. The market gate is wide enough.
bargain.paid: Bought for {price}. The seller slips in an extra plastic bag.
bargain.closed: The seller won’t serve you any more today.
bargain.rules: An offer close to the seller’s price is taken. Offers that are too low wear out their patience; when it runs out, the stall closes on you for the day. Pretend to walk away once: a seller with patience left calls you back with a better price. Five rounds, then the last price stands.
lomba.title: Lomba 17-an on the Sukamaju pitch
lomba.intro: The RT committee has set up the greasy pole, the burlap sacks and the cracker strings. Pick your contest!
lomba.hasPita: This year’s Pita Merah Putih: won
lomba.noPita: This year’s Pita Merah Putih: not yet
lomba.ribbons: Ribbons this year: {n}/{total}. All ribbons you have ever won: {all}.
lomba.reward: Win: a daily prize of Rp5.000 and 2 Capsules; first win this year: a Pita Merah Putih and an Ultra Capsule.
lomba.paidToday: This contest’s daily prize is claimed. The yearly ribbon can still be won!
lomba.pita: A Pita Merah Putih for you, with 1 Ultra Capsule! ({n}/{total} this year)
lomba.bendera: All three ribbons: the Bendera Merah Putih (red-and-white flag)! The committee gives {money} (17-8-45) and a Guard Vest.
lomba.penalti.name: The 17-an penalty shoot-out
lomba.penalti.desc: Five kicks against the quicker contest keeper. Four goals win the Piala Agustusan.
lomba.pinang.name: Panjat pinang (greasy pole)
lomba.pinang.desc: A pole slick with oil, prizes hanging at the top.
lomba.pinang.rules: Climb hand over hand: ← then →, again and again. The same hand twice makes you slip, and the grease keeps dragging you down. Reach the top within {n} seconds!
lomba.pinang.win: You reach the top and seize the prizes! The crowd cheers, “Merdeka!”
lomba.pinang.lose: Time’s up at {n}% of the pole. Your shirt is covered in grease, but not your spirit.
lomba.karung.name: Balap karung (sack race)
lomba.karung.desc: Hop in a burlap sack to the 100 m line.
lomba.karung.rules: Press Hop as the sack’s spring peaks (green bar): a good hop goes 4.5 m, a perfect one 6 m. Mistime it and you trip. Beat Dik Ucup, Bang Jali and Mbak Sinta to the finish line!
lomba.karung.slow: Time ran out before the finish line. Maybe the sack was too big?
lomba.karung.trip: Tripped! Wait for the spring to peak.
lomba.karung.status: Wait for the green bar, then hop!
lomba.kerupuk.name: Makan kerupuk (cracker-eating)
lomba.kerupuk.desc: Hands behind your back: finish the hanging cracker before Krupik does.
lomba.kerupuk.rules: Hands behind your back! Bite when the swinging cracker is right in front of your mouth; miss and it bumps your nose. Six bites finish it. {name} finishes its cracker in {n} seconds.
lomba.kerupuk.win: Your cracker is gone first! {name} gapes, crumbs on its claws.
lomba.kerupuk.lose: {name} finishes its cracker first and does a victory dance. Crunch!
lomba.kerupuk.challenge: {name} sulks at losing and challenges you to a match!
lomba.kerupuk.battle: {name} is still covered in cracker crumbs, and very offended!
lomba.kerupuk.miss: Bonk! The cracker bumps your nose.
culture.sinta.offer: When there are no passengers I fly kites over the field. A good kite brings {name} swooping down, you know.
culture.wayang.title: Wayang at the balai
culture.wayang.offer: Tonight Pak Joni performs part {n} of {total} of the lakon (play) “Wargamon, Guardian of the Kampung” as dalang (puppeteer), with gamelan.
culture.wayang.tomorrow: Today’s part of the play has been performed. The next part is tomorrow.
culture.wayang.over: The play “Wargamon, Guardian of the Kampung” has ended. Pak Joni is preparing a new one.
culture.wayang.progress: Parts watched: {n}/{total}. See it to the end for a gift from the dalang.
culture.wayang.gift: The play is over! The dalang gives you {money} and 3 Ultra Capsules, “for the most faithful audience.”
culture.wayang.part.0.title: The gunungan opens
culture.wayang.part.0.body: The gunungan (tree-of-life puppet) spins across the screen as the gamelan swells. Long ago this kampung was silent: Wargamon and people feared each other, each hiding behind their fences.
culture.wayang.part.1.title: The child and the capsule
culture.wayang.part.1.body: A child finds a cracked capsule in the bushes behind the kitchen. Inside, a small trembling Wargamon. The child offers it a piece of tempe. The audience laughs: tempe is the answer to everything.
culture.wayang.part.2.title: The punakawan arrive
culture.wayang.part.2.body: Semar, Gareng, Petruk and Bagong, the clown-servants, appear with advice and jokes. Petruk wants to catch every Wargamon; Semar says what matters is not how many, but how well they get along.
culture.wayang.part.3.title: The Flood Demon
culture.wayang.part.3.body: A flood giant comes down from upstream. The fences wash away. The child and the little Wargamon build a dyke of sandbags, and the people who once were afraid join in.
culture.wayang.part.4.title: The flower battle
culture.wayang.part.4.body: The gamelan rises to its peak. The child and their Wargamon dance the perang kembang (flower battle) against the giant: not to destroy it, but to send it home to the sea.
culture.wayang.part.5.title: The limbukan interlude
culture.wayang.part.5.body: A comic interlude: Limbuk and Cangik gossip about chilli prices and who won the futsal. Pak Joni teases the audience members who have nodded off. They do not hear him.
culture.wayang.part.6.title: Tancep kayon: the close
culture.wayang.part.6.body: Since then the kampung fences have been kept low, so Wargamon and people can greet each other. The gunungan is planted in the middle of the screen: the play is over, and the rooster crows.
culture.silat.offer: Kakek was a pencak silat fighter, you know. Want to practise reading an opponent’s stance?
culture.silat.title: Reading the stance
culture.silat.rules: Weight on the back foot means a kick: block (tangkis). Fists at the hip mean a punch: dodge (elak). Low and wide means a sweep: jump (lompat). Three right answers give the team a silat warm-up’s focus for 3 battles.
culture.silat.stance.tendang: Kakek shifts his weight onto his back foot, his knee lifting a little.
culture.silat.stance.pukul: Kakek clenches his fists at his hip, his shoulder turning.
culture.silat.stance.sapu: Kakek drops low, his legs spreading wide across the ground.
culture.silat.again: {n} of {total} right. “Again, again. A fighter isn’t made in a day.”
culture.silat.win: Three out of three! Kakek pats your shoulder. The team gains a silat warm-up’s focus for 3 battles.
culture.reog.offer: A reog Ponorogo troupe is rehearsing. The dadak merak, the warok’s peacock mask, weighs fifty kilos and is lifted with the teeth. Is any of your teammates strong enough?
culture.reog.title: The dadak merak
culture.reog.lift: {name} bites the dadak merak and lifts it high! The troupe cheers and the drums thunder: the team is fired up, hitting harder for 3 battles.
culture.reog.fail: The mask doesn’t budge an inch. The warok laughs: “You need a stronger teammate. Level 25, or a Batu or Logam type at level 15.”
culture.jajan.title: Snacks from the cart
culture.jajan.cilokDesc: Chewy tapioca balls in peanut sauce: team Fullness +35
culture.jajan.cilokDone: Chewy, sweet-spicy cilok. The team is full!
culture.jajan.seblak: Seblak (spicy crackers in broth), {price}. Pick the chilli level: each level is one battle of stronger attacks, but from level 4 your lead gets Terbakar (burned), unless it is an Api type.
culture.jajan.seblakDone: Level-{n} seblak: warm and tasty. Stronger attacks for {n} battles.
culture.jajan.seblakHot: Level-{n} seblak! {name} is so spicy it is Terbakar (burned), but you hit harder for {n} battles.
culture.jajan.seblakApi: Level-{n} seblak? {name}, an Api type, wolfs it down without a bead of sweat. Stronger attacks for {n} battles.
mudik.lebaran.rewardNoThr: You already had today’s THR from Pak RT in town, so at home it is ketupat and opor: the team is healed, full, and gets {effect} for 3 battles.
resident.100.4: Want today’s weather? Read Kabar Warga at the Wargamaret. When it floods, water Wargamon swim right up to my cart.
resident.103.4: At school we learnt batik with a canting pen. My shirt is batik now too, in the spilt-wax pattern.
resident.104.4: Kids these days prefer cilok and seblak to jamu. That’s fine, they’ll come looking for Bu Tini when they catch a chill.
resident.107.4: Every morning I take the KRL commuter train from Stasiun Sela, standing and hugging parcels. Yesterday an ondel-ondel got on too, and the whole carriage was squashed!
resident.108.4: My brother is a guide in Labuan Bajo. He says the komodos there walk slowly, but when they’re hungry they outrun an ojek.
resident.109.4: Last month I drove a group train to Borobudur. One little stupa seemed to follow us home. Probably just my imagination. Probably.
resident.110.4: A workshop without dangdut is like a tyre without air. Spanner in hand, a sway in the hips.
